summaryZh: 使用 W-Sim Host 转换已有节点与单元输入，下载 Elmer native mesh 四文件文本。
summaryEn: Use the W-Sim Host conversion operation to export existing nodes and elements as four Elmer native mesh text files.

explainRoot.titleZh: 方法：ElmerGrid 网格文本导出
explainRoot.bodyZh: 此工作流只转换用户提供的节点和单元并输出 mesh.header、mesh.nodes、mesh.elements 与空 mesh.boundary；不会创建几何、边界条件或父单元关系，也不执行 ElmerSolver。
explainRoot.bodyEn: This workflow converts user-provided nodes and elements into mesh.header, mesh.nodes, mesh.elements, and an empty mesh.boundary. It creates no geometry, boundary conditions, or parent-element relations and does not run ElmerSolver.

children.titleZh: 基础：节点编号与单元连通关系
children.titleEn: Foundation: node labels and element connectivity
children.bodyZh: Elmer native mesh 文本把节点坐标与单元拓扑分开存储：每个单元引用已定义的节点标签，header 给出节点/单元计数和维度。此导出保留调用者提供的标签与连接，不生成几何、边界条件或父单元关系。
children.bodyEn: Elmer native mesh text stores node coordinates and element connectivity separately. Each element references defined node labels; the header records counts and dimensions. This export preserves caller-provided labels and connectivity and does not generate geometry, boundary conditions, or parent-element relations.

summaryZh: 理想 MHD 中磁张力与惯性平衡给出的特征波速 vA = B/√(μ0 ρ)。
summaryEn: Ideal-MHD characteristic speed from magnetic tension vs inertia.

explainRoot.bodyZh: 顶层计算方法：给定 B 与质量密度 ρ，输出特征波速 vA。教学 L0 路径可本地求值；工程侧可挂到 MHD/等离子体相关 kind。
explainRoot.bodyEn: Top method: given B and mass density ρ, output characteristic speed vA.

children.titleZh: 原理：磁张力与惯性
children.bodyZh: 扰动在磁化等离子体中传播时，磁张力提供恢复力，惯性由质量密度承担。量级上波速 ~ 力/惯性 的开方。
children.bodyEn: Magnetic tension restores; mass density supplies inertia. Wave speed scales as sqrt(tension/inertia).

children.titleZh: 基础式：vA = B / √(μ0 ρ)
children.bodyZh: SI 单位：B 特斯拉，ρ kg/m³，μ0 H/m，vA m/s。要求 ρ>0、μ0>0。
children.bodyEn: SI units; require ρ>0, μ0>0.

formula.plainZh: 由磁感应强度与质量密度计算阿尔芬波速
formula.plainEn: Alfvén speed from magnetic field and mass density

children.titleZh: 基础常数：μ0
children.bodyZh: 真空磁导率 μ0 ≈ 0.00000125663706212 H/m（CODATA 量级约定）。教学路径固定该常数。
children.bodyEn: Vacuum permeability μ0 ≈ 0.00000125663706212 H/m.

children.titleZh: 假设与有效域
children.bodyZh: 理想 MHD、忽略电阻与热压主导的情形；ρ 过小或非有限输入返回 NaN。教学玩具默认 B、ρ 取实验室等离子体量级。
children.bodyEn: Ideal MHD toy; non-finite or non-positive ρ → NaN. Default B,ρ are lab-plasma class.

children.titleZh: L0 教学叶子
children.bodyZh: 实现：`src/lib/sim/alfven-algos.ts` 的 alfvenSpeed / runAlfvenVSample。不计入 engineering DoD。
children.bodyEn: Implemented in alfven-algos.ts; not engineering DoD credit.

titleZh: IGBT 电热 Foster（工程 kind）
summaryZh: W-Sim BuiltinJobKind electro-thermal-igbt：功率器件结温 / Foster 热阻–热容网络工程路径；教学落到 Rθ、τ、阶跃响应。
summaryEn: W-Sim kind electro-thermal-igbt: junction Foster R–C network; drills to Rθ, τ, step response.

explainRoot.bodyZh: 顶层工程计算方法：将电气损耗映射到 Foster（或部分 Cauer）热网络，输出结温 Tj、温升与热 KPI。数值实现归 @w-sim/solvers-thermal。
explainRoot.bodyEn: Maps electrical loss into a Foster thermal network; owned by @w-sim/solvers-thermal.

children.titleZh: 原理：损耗 → 热源
children.bodyZh: 导通损耗 ~ I·Vce(sat)、开关损耗 ~ Eon/Eoff·fsw 等汇总为热源功率 P；注入 Foster 网络的结侧端口，驱动温升响应。
children.bodyEn: Conduction + switching loss sum to heat power P injected at the junction port of the Foster network.

children.titleZh: 基础式：ΔT = P · Rθ
children.bodyZh: 稳态量级：结到参考点的温升约等于损耗功率乘总热阻。多层时 Rθ,total = Σ R_i（Foster 支路稳态电阻之和）。
children.bodyEn: Steady order: junction rise ≈ P × Rθ,total; multilayer Rθ,total = Σ R_i.

formula.plainZh: 稳态温升约等于功率乘热阻
formula.plainEn: Steady temperature rise ≈ power × thermal resistance

children.titleZh: 基础：损耗合成 P = Pcond + Psw
children.bodyZh: 量级上把导通与开关损耗相加作为 Foster 注入功率；更细可分芯片/封装多热源，但 smoke 常以单端口 P 驱动。
children.bodyEn: Order-of-magnitude P = Pcond + Psw into one Foster port; multi-source models optional.

formula.plainZh: 总损耗等于导通损耗与开关损耗之和
formula.plainEn: Total loss is conduction plus switching loss

children.titleZh: 原理：Foster 热阻抗网络
children.bodyZh: Foster 把 Zth(jω) 拟合成若干并联 R–C 支路：Zth(s) = Σ R_i/(1 + s τ_i)，τ_i = R_i C_i。便于 datasheet 曲线拟合；Cauer 更贴近分层物理，二者可互化。
children.bodyEn: Foster fits Zth as parallel R–C branches Zth=Σ R_i/(1+sτ_i); Cauer maps layered structure.

children.titleZh: 基础式：τ = R · C
children.bodyZh: 单支路热时间常数 τ = Rθ · Cθ。短 τ 对应芯片/焊层快响应，长 τ 对应封装/散热器慢通道。
children.bodyEn: Branch thermal time constant τ = Rθ · Cθ; short/long τ map die vs package paths.

formula.plainZh: 热时间常数等于支路热阻乘热容
formula.plainEn: Thermal time constant is branch resistance times capacitance

children.titleZh: 基础式：单支路阶跃 ΔT(t) = P R (1 − e^{−t/τ})
children.titleEn: Foundation: step ΔT(t) = P R (1 − e^{−t/τ})
children.bodyZh: 恒功率阶跃下单 Foster 支路的温升响应。t→∞ 时 ΔT→P R；t=τ 时约达 63% 稳态。多层为各支路响应之和。
children.bodyEn: Constant-power step on one Foster branch; multi-layer sums branches.

formula.plainZh: 单支路 Foster 阶跃温升随时间按指数趋近 PR
formula.plainEn: Single-branch Foster step rise approaches PR exponentially

children.titleZh: 基础：多层稳态 Rθ,total = Σ R_i
children.bodyZh: Foster 各支路在直流（s→0）下退化为纯电阻叠加于温升：Rθ,jc = Σ R_i。工程 smoke 常校验多层 Rθ 与结构函数残差。
children.bodyEn: DC limit of Foster: Rθ,total = Σ R_i; smoke checks multilayer Rθ and structure-function residual.

formula.plainZh: Foster 多层稳态总热阻等于各支路热阻之和
formula.plainEn: Steady multilayer Foster Rθ is the sum of branch resistances

children.titleZh: 基础：Foster / Cauer 对照
children.bodyZh: Foster 便于拟合 Zth(t)/Zth(jω)；Cauer 节点对应物理分层（芯片–焊料–基板–壳）。二者传递函数可等价变换；本 kind 工程路径以 Foster 拟合 + 结温 KPI 为主。
children.bodyEn: Foster fits curves; Cauer maps layers; transfer functions can be equivalent.

children.titleZh: 原理：结温与参考点
children.bodyZh: Tj = Tref + ΔTj-ref。Tref 可为壳温 Tc、散热器 Ts 或环境 Ta，取决于 Rθ 链截断点；过温保护与 derating 看 Tj 上限。
children.bodyEn: Tj = Tref + ΔT; reference may be case, sink, or ambient depending on Rθ chain cut.

children.titleZh: 基础式：Tj = Tref + ΔT
children.bodyZh: 绝对结温 = 参考温度 + 网络给出的温升。要求与 Rθ 定义的参考点一致。
children.bodyEn: Absolute junction temperature = reference + network rise.

formula.plainZh: 结温等于参考温度加网络温升
formula.plainEn: Junction temperature is reference plus network temperature rise

children.titleZh: 假设与有效域
children.bodyZh: 线性时不变热网络、单端口或少端口注入；忽略封装非线性辐射/接触、强耦合多芯片热点需扩展。工程 smoke 覆盖多层 Rθ、阶跃/脉冲结温与结构函数残差。
children.bodyEn: LTI thermal network; nonlinear radiation / multi-chip hotspots need extensions.

children.titleZh: 工程包：solvers-thermal
children.bodyZh: JobKind `electro-thermal-igbt` 由 @w-sim/solvers-thermal 拥有；经 kind-matrix 与 lab-kit 登记（multi-pulse duty / Dragomir B 系列 vs-rect residual S24o–S24bc + B₃₂/B₃₃ dual S24bf + B₃₄/B₃₅ dual S24bg + B₃₆/B₃₇ dual S24bh + B₃₈/B₃₉ dual S24bi + B₄₀/B₄₁ dual S24bj + B₄₂/B₄₃ dual S24bk + B₄₄/B₄₅ dual S24bl 等 fixture）。**smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation**。
children.bodyEn: Owned by @w-sim/solvers-thermal; kind-matrix + lab-kit fixtures including multi-pulse duty / Dragomir B-series vs-rect residual S24o–S24bc + B32/B33 dual S24bf + B34/B35 dual S24bg + B36/B37 dual S24bh + B38/B39 dual S24bi + B40/B41 dual S24bj + B42/B43 dual S24bk + B44/B45 dual S24bl; smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation.

children.titleZh: 合成视角：损耗模型 ∘ Foster 网络 ≈ 电热方法
children.titleEn: Compose: loss model ∘ Foster network ≈ electro-thermal method
children.bodyZh: 科技树语义：更基础的「损耗合成 / 占空 / 开关能量 / 全链 P / 占空 RMS·crest·form·util / 周期能量 / 电方差」与「Foster R–C / 阶跃 / Zth / 热容储能 / Rjc+Rca / 裕度 / Hellinger·Bhattacharyya·Dragomir dual residual packaging（含 B₃₂/B₃₃、B₃₄/B₃₅、B₃₆/B₃₇、B₃₈/B₃₉、B₄₀/B₄₁、B₄₂/B₄₃、B₄₄/B₄₅）」合成应在等价域复现顶层 IGBT 结温与 Rθ KPI（稳态 ΔT、Tj、多层阶跃、τ、Rθ 匹配残差、Zth(t)、多层 Zth、ΔT=P·Zth、63% 响应、阶跃→稳态残差、Q=C·ΔT、Rθ=ΔT/P 反推、初斜率 P/C、进度 α、Tj 裕度、τ 匹配、占空电学 KPI、vs-rect 距离/Dragomir 诚实门）。对应 foundation 的损耗/Foster 闭式；数值 residual tip 桥接 @w-sim/solvers-thermal multi-pulse duty + Dragomir B 系列（S24o–S24bc + S24bf B₃₂/B₃₃ + S24bg B₃₄/B₃₅ + S24bh B₃₆/B₃₇ + S24bi B₃₈/B₃₉ dual packaging + S24bj B₄₀/B₄₁ dual packaging + S24bk B₄₂/B₄₃ dual packaging + S24bl B₄₄/B₄₅ dual packaging（landed）；下接 S24bm）——**smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation**。
children.bodyEn: Composing loss/duty/switching/full-chain P + duty RMS·crest·form·util + cycle energy/variance + Foster R–C/step/Zth/storage/Rjc+Rca/margin + Hellinger·Bhattacharyya·Dragomir dual residual packaging (incl. B32/B33, B34/B35, B36/B37, B38/B39, B40/B41, B42/B43, B44/B45) should reproduce Tj/Rθ KPIs (steady ΔT, Tj, multi-branch step, τ, Rθ match, Zth(t), multi Zth, ΔT=P·Zth, 63% rise, step-to-steady residual, Q=C·ΔT, Rθ=ΔT/P invert, initial P/C slope, progress α, Tj margin, τ match, duty electrical KPIs, vs-rect distance/Dragomir honesty gates); bridges @w-sim/solvers-thermal multi-pulse duty + Dragomir B-series (S24o–S24bc + S24bf B32/B33 + S24bg B34/B35 + S24bh B36/B37 + S24bi B38/B39 dual packaging + S24bj B40/B41 dual packaging + S24bk B42/B43 dual packaging + S24bl B44/B45 dual packaging (landed); next S24bm) — smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation.

children.titleZh: 合成：稳态 ΔT = P · Rθ,total
children.bodyZh: 把损耗功率与多层稳态热阻合成：ΔT_ss = P · Σ R_i。连接 principle「损耗→热源」与「Foster 网络」。
children.bodyEn: Composes loss power with multilayer steady Rθ: ΔT_ss = P · Σ R_i; links loss principle to Foster network.

formula.plainZh: 稳态温升等于损耗功率乘 Foster 总热阻
formula.plainEn: Steady temperature rise is loss power times total Foster Rθ

children.titleZh: 合成：Tj = Tref + P · Rθ
children.bodyZh: 绝对结温合同：参考点 + 稳态温升。算例 Tref=25°C、P=100 W、Rθ=0.5 K/W → Tj=75°C。
children.bodyEn: Absolute junction contract: reference + steady rise; sample 25°C + 50 K → 75°C.

formula.plainZh: 结温等于参考温度加功率乘热阻的温升
formula.plainEn: Junction temperature is reference plus power times thermal resistance

children.titleZh: 合成：多层阶跃 ΔT = Σ P R_i (1 − e^{−t/τ_i})
children.titleEn: Compose: multi-branch step ΔT = Σ P R_i (1 − e^{−t/τ_i})
children.bodyZh: Foster 并联支路对恒功率阶跃的温升叠加。算例两支路在 t=τ₁ 时取一支 63% 稳态、另一支近稳态近似。
children.bodyEn: Multi-branch Foster step sums exponential rises under constant power.

formula.expr: dT = P * (R1 * (1 - exp(-t / tau1)) + R2 * (1 - exp(-t / tau2)))

vars.tau1: 第 1 支路时间常数 s
vars.tau2: 第 2 支路时间常数 s

formula.plainZh: 多层 Foster 阶跃温升等于各支路指数响应之和
formula.plainEn: Multi-branch Foster step rise is the sum of branch exponential responses

children.titleZh: 合成：τ = R · C 与支路响应
children.titleEn: Compose: τ = R · C with branch response
children.bodyZh: 把支路热阻与热容合成时间常数；短 τ 快通道、长 τ 慢通道共同构成 Zth(t) 曲线。
children.bodyEn: Composes branch R and C into τ; short/long τ form Zth(t) shape.

formula.plainZh: 合成热时间常数等于支路热阻乘热容
formula.plainEn: Composed thermal time constant is branch R times C

children.titleZh: 合成：注入功率 P = Pcond + Psw
children.bodyZh: 电侧损耗合成作为 Foster 端口注入；与热侧 R–C 合成后得结温 KPI。
children.bodyEn: Electrical loss sum injects the Foster port; composed with R–C yields Tj KPIs.

formula.plainZh: Foster 注入功率等于导通损耗与开关损耗之和
formula.plainEn: Foster injection power is conduction plus switching loss

children.titleZh: 合成：Rθ,total = R1 + R2 + R3 入稳态链
children.titleEn: Compose: Rθ,total = R1+R2+R3 into steady chain
children.bodyZh: 把各 Foster 支路热阻合成直流总 Rθ，再进入 ΔT=P·Rθ 与 Tj 合同。算例 0.15+0.25+0.1=0.5 K/W。
children.bodyEn: Composes branch R_i into DC total Rθ upstream of ΔT=P·Rθ and Tj; sample sum 0.5 K/W.

formula.plainZh: Foster 总热阻由各支路热阻合成，再进入稳态温升链
formula.plainEn: Total Foster Rθ composes from branch resistances before the steady-rise chain

children.titleZh: 合成：Zth(t) = R (1 − e^{−t/τ})
children.bodyZh: 把支路 R 与 τ 合成瞬态热阻抗；恒功率下 ΔT(t)=P·Zth(t)。t=τ 时 Zth≈0.632 R。
children.bodyEn: Composes branch R and τ into transient Zth; ΔT(t)=P·Zth under constant power; at t=τ, Zth≈0.632 R.

formula.plainZh: 瞬态热阻抗由支路热阻与时间常数按指数趋近 R 合成
formula.plainEn: Transient thermal impedance composes from branch R and τ approaching R exponentially

children.titleZh: 合成：t=τ 时 ΔT ≈ 0.632 P R
children.bodyZh: 单支路阶跃在一个时间常数处到达约 63.2% 稳态温升。算例 P=100、R=0.5 → ΔT≈31.606 K。
children.bodyEn: Single-branch step reaches ~63.2% of steady rise at one τ; sample ≈31.606 K.

formula.plainZh: 一个时间常数处的 Foster 阶跃温升约为稳态的 63.2%
formula.plainEn: Foster step rise at one time constant is about 63.2% of the steady value

children.titleZh: 合成：C = τ / R 反推热容
children.titleEn: Compose: C = τ / R invert thermal capacitance
children.bodyZh: 从 datasheet 拟合的 (R,τ) 反推支路热容 C=τ/R，供 Cauer 变换或能量估算。算例 τ=0.1、R=0.2 → C=0.5 J/K。
children.bodyEn: Inverts fitted (R,τ) into branch C=τ/R for Cauer map or energy estimates; sample C=0.5 J/K.

formula.plainZh: 支路热容由时间常数除以热阻反推合成
formula.plainEn: Branch thermal capacitance composes as time constant over resistance

children.titleZh: 合成：Psw = (Eon + Eoff) · fsw
children.bodyZh: 把开关能量与开关频率合成平均开关损耗，再与 Pcond 合成注入 P。算例 Eon+Eoff=2 mJ、fsw=10 kHz → Psw=20 W。
children.bodyEn: Composes switching energies and fsw into average Psw before total P; sample 20 W.

formula.plainZh: 平均开关损耗由开通/关断能量与开关频率合成
formula.plainEn: Average switching loss composes from turn-on/off energies and switching frequency

children.titleZh: 合成：Pcond = I · Vce
children.bodyZh: 导通损耗量级 I·Vce(sat)（或占空修正后的平均）。算例 I=40 A、Vce=2 V → Pcond=80 W，与 loss-inject 样例对齐。
children.bodyEn: Conduction-loss order I·Vce(sat) (duty-averaged when needed); sample 80 W aligns with loss-inject.

formula.plainZh: 导通损耗由导通电流与饱和压降合成
formula.plainEn: Conduction loss composes from on-state current and saturation voltage

children.titleZh: 合成：Pavg = Ppeak · D 占空平均
children.titleEn: Compose: Pavg = Ppeak · D duty average
children.bodyZh: 脉冲/PWM 工况下把峰值损耗与占空比合成平均注入功率，再驱动 Foster 长时温升。算例 Ppeak=200 W、D=0.5 → Pavg=100 W。
children.bodyEn: Composes peak loss and duty into average injection for long-horizon Foster rise; sample 100 W.

formula.plainZh: 平均损耗功率由峰值损耗与占空比合成
formula.plainEn: Average loss power composes from peak loss and duty cycle

children.titleZh: 合成：Q = C · ΔT 热容储能
children.titleEn: Compose: Q = C · ΔT thermal storage
children.bodyZh: 支路热容储能尺度：温升 ΔT 时储存热量 Q=C·ΔT。算例 C=0.5 J/K、ΔT=50 K → Q=25 J，连接 τ=RC 与阶跃能量。
children.bodyEn: Branch storage scale Q=C·ΔT; sample 25 J; links τ=RC to step energy.

formula.plainZh: 热容储能等于热容乘温升，连接 Foster 支路与能量尺度
formula.plainEn: Thermal storage energy is capacitance times temperature rise, linking Foster branches to energy scale

children.titleZh: 合成：ΔT(t) = P · Zth(t)
children.bodyZh: 恒功率下把注入功率与瞬态热阻抗合成瞬时温升。算例 P=100、Zth(t=τ)=0.5·(1−e^{−1}) → ΔT≈31.606 K，与 step-63 同值。
children.bodyEn: Composes injection power with transient Zth into rise under constant power; sample matches step-63.

formula.plainZh: 瞬时温升等于损耗功率乘瞬态热阻抗
formula.plainEn: Instantaneous temperature rise is loss power times transient thermal impedance

children.titleZh: 合成：多层 Zth(t) = Σ R_i (1 − e^{−t/τ_i})
children.titleEn: Compose: multi-branch Zth(t) = Σ R_i (1 − e^{−t/τ_i})
children.bodyZh: 把各 Foster 支路的指数响应合成多层瞬态热阻抗；恒功率下 ΔT=P·Zth。算例与 step-sum 的 (R,τ,t) 对齐：Zth=dT/P。
children.bodyEn: Composes branch exponential responses into multi-branch Zth; ΔT=P·Zth; sample aligns with step-sum.

formula.expr: Zth = R1 * (1 - exp(-t / tau1)) + R2 * (1 - exp(-t / tau2))

vars.tau1: 第 1 支路时间常数 s
vars.tau2: 第 2 支路时间常数 s

formula.plainZh: 多层 Foster 瞬态热阻抗由各支路指数响应之和合成
formula.plainEn: Multi-branch Foster transient impedance composes as the sum of branch exponential responses

children.titleZh: 合成：Rθ = ΔT / P 反推热阻
children.titleEn: Compose: Rθ = ΔT / P invert thermal resistance
children.bodyZh: 稳态或已知温升下反推有效热阻，连接实测 ΔT 与 datasheet Rθ。算例 ΔT=50 K、P=100 W → Rθ=0.5 K/W。
children.bodyEn: Inverts measured steady rise into effective Rθ; sample 50 K / 100 W → 0.5 K/W.

formula.plainZh: 有效热阻由稳态温升除以损耗功率反推合成
formula.plainEn: Effective thermal resistance composes as steady rise over loss power

children.titleZh: 合成：P = I·Vce·D + (Eon+Eoff)·fsw 全链损耗
children.titleEn: Compose: P = I·Vce·D + (Eon+Eoff)·fsw full loss chain
children.bodyZh: 把占空修正导通损耗与开关能量–频率链一次合成注入功率。算例 I=80、Vce=2、D=0.5 → Pcond=80；Eon+Eoff=2 mJ、fsw=10 kHz → Psw=20；P=100 W。
children.bodyEn: Composes duty-averaged conduction and switching chain into injection P; sample 100 W.

formula.expr: P = I * Vce * D + (Eon + Eoff) * fsw
formula.plainZh: 全链损耗由占空导通损耗与开关能量频率项合成
formula.plainEn: Full loss chain composes duty-averaged conduction with switching energy–frequency term

children.titleZh: 合成：Pcond = I · Vce · D 占空导通
children.titleEn: Compose: Pcond = I · Vce · D duty conduction
children.bodyZh: PWM 导通损耗把 I·Vce 与占空比合成平均导通功率。算例 I=80 A、Vce=2 V、D=0.5 → Pcond=80 W，对齐 loss-inject。
children.bodyEn: PWM conduction averages I·Vce by duty; sample 80 W aligns with loss-inject.

formula.plainZh: 平均导通损耗由电流、饱和压降与占空比合成
formula.plainEn: Average conduction loss composes from current, saturation voltage, and duty cycle

children.titleZh: 合成：Esw = Eon + Eoff 开关周期能量
children.titleEn: Compose: Esw = Eon + Eoff switching energy per cycle
children.bodyZh: 把开通与关断能量合成单开关周期开关能量，再乘 fsw 得 Psw。算例 1.2 mJ + 0.8 mJ = 2 mJ。
children.bodyEn: Composes turn-on/off energies into per-cycle switching energy before ×fsw; sample 2 mJ.

formula.plainZh: 开关周期能量由开通与关断能量合成
formula.plainEn: Per-cycle switching energy composes from turn-on and turn-off energies

children.titleZh: 合成：初斜率 dT/dt|₀ = P / C
children.titleEn: Compose: initial slope dT/dt|₀ = P / C
children.bodyZh: 单支路阶跃极短时限：热容尚未经 R 泄放，初斜率 ≈ P/C。算例 P=100、C=0.5 → 200 K/s，连接 Q=C·ΔT 与 τ=RC。
children.bodyEn: Short-time single-branch limit: initial slope ≈ P/C; sample 200 K/s; links Q=C·ΔT and τ=RC.

formula.plainZh: 阶跃初温升斜率等于功率除以热容
formula.plainEn: Initial step temperature slope is power over thermal capacitance

children.titleZh: 合成：进度 α = 1 − e^{−t/τ}
children.bodyZh: 单支路阶跃相对稳态的完成进度；t=τ 时 α≈0.632。与 Zth=R·α、dT=P R α 同源。
children.bodyEn: Single-branch step progress toward steady; α≈0.632 at t=τ; same root as Zth=R·α.

formula.plainZh: 单支路阶跃进度由归一化时间 t/τ 的指数合成
formula.plainEn: Single-branch step progress composes from the exponential of normalized time t/τ

children.titleZh: 合成：Rθ,ja = Rjc + Rca 热阻链
children.titleEn: Compose: Rθ,ja = Rjc + Rca thermal chain
children.bodyZh: 把结–壳与壳–环境（或壳–散热器）热阻合成结–环境总链，再进入 ΔT=P·Rja 与 Tj 合同。算例 0.3+0.2=0.5 K/W。
children.bodyEn: Composes junction–case and case–ambient (or sink) into junction–ambient chain; sample 0.5 K/W.

formula.plainZh: 结–环境总热阻由结–壳与壳–环境热阻链合成
formula.plainEn: Junction-to-ambient thermal resistance composes from junction–case and case–ambient segments

children.titleZh: 合成：E = P · t_on 脉冲能量
children.titleEn: Compose: E = P · t_on pulse energy
children.bodyZh: 短脉冲注入能量尺度，连接损耗功率与热容储能 Q；若 t_on≪τ 则近似绝热 ΔT≈E/C。算例 P=100 W、t_on=0.01 s → E=1 J。
children.bodyEn: Short-pulse energy scale linking P to storage Q; if t_on≪τ then ΔT≈E/C; sample 1 J.

formula.plainZh: 脉冲能量由功率与开通脉宽合成
formula.plainEn: Pulse energy composes from power and on-time width

children.titleZh: 合成：P_rms = Ppeak · √D 占空 RMS
children.bodyZh: 矩形占空电学 RMS：P_rms=Ppeak·√D。算例 Ppeak=100、D=0.25 → P_rms=50；桥接 S24r rmsPowerW / periodRmsResidual。
children.bodyEn: Rectangular duty electrical RMS P_rms=Ppeak·√D; sample 100×0.5=50; bridges S24r rmsPowerW / periodRmsResidual.

vars.P_rms: 占空 RMS 功率 W

formula.plainZh: 占空 RMS 功率等于峰值功率乘占空比的平方根
formula.plainEn: Duty RMS power is peak power times the square root of the duty cycle

children.titleZh: 合成：crest = 1/√D 占空波峰因数
children.bodyZh: 矩形占空 crest=peak/rms=1/√D。算例 D=0.25 → crest=2；桥接 S24s periodCrestResidual 电学金标。
children.bodyEn: Rectangular crest=peak/rms=1/√D; sample D=0.25 → 2; bridges S24s periodCrestResidual electrical gold.

formula.plainZh: 矩形占空波峰因数等于占空比平方根的倒数
formula.plainEn: Rectangular duty crest factor is the reciprocal of the square root of duty

children.titleZh: 合成：form = 1/√D 占空波形因数
children.bodyZh: 矩形占空 form=rms/mean=1/√D，与 crest 同形。算例 D=0.25 → form=2；桥接 S24s periodFormResidual。
children.bodyEn: Rectangular form=rms/mean=1/√D (same shape as crest); sample D=0.25 → 2; bridges S24s periodFormResidual.

formula.plainZh: 矩形占空波形因数等于占空比平方根的倒数
formula.plainEn: Rectangular duty form factor is the reciprocal of the square root of duty

children.titleZh: 合成：util = D 占空利用率
children.bodyZh: 矩形占空 util=mean/peak=D。算例 D=0.25 → util=0.25；桥接 S24t periodUtilResidual 电学金标。
children.bodyEn: Rectangular util=mean/peak=D; sample 0.25; bridges S24t periodUtilResidual electrical gold.

formula.plainZh: 矩形占空利用率等于占空比本身
formula.plainEn: Rectangular duty utilization equals the duty cycle itself

children.titleZh: 合成：peakToMean = 1/D 峰均比
children.bodyZh: 矩形占空 peak/mean=1/D（=crest×form）。算例 D=0.25 → 4；桥接 S24t periodPeakToMeanResidual。
children.bodyEn: Rectangular peak/mean=1/D (=crest×form); sample D=0.25 → 4; bridges S24t periodPeakToMeanResidual.

formula.plainZh: 矩形占空峰均比等于占空比的倒数
formula.plainEn: Rectangular duty peak-to-mean ratio is the reciprocal of the duty cycle

children.titleZh: 合成：var = P² · D · (1−D) 占空电方差
children.titleEn: Compose: var = P² · D · (1−D) duty electrical variance
children.bodyZh: 矩形功率两态 {0,P} 方差 P²D(1−D)。算例 P=100、D=0.25 → var=1875；桥接 S24v periodVarResidual。
children.bodyEn: Two-state {0,P} variance P²D(1−D); sample 100²·0.25·0.75=1875; bridges S24v periodVarResidual.

formula.plainZh: 矩形占空电方差等于峰值功率平方乘占空比乘（1−占空比）
formula.plainEn: Rectangular duty electrical variance is peak power squared times D times (1−D)

children.titleZh: 合成：std = P · √(D(1−D)) 占空电标准差
children.titleEn: Compose: std = P · √(D(1−D)) duty electrical std
children.bodyZh: 电标准差 √var=P√(D(1−D))。算例 P=100、D=0.25 → std=25√3；桥接 S24v periodStdResidual。
children.bodyEn: Electrical std √var=P√(D(1−D)); sample 100√0.1875; bridges S24v periodStdResidual.

formula.plainZh: 矩形占空电标准差等于峰值功率乘 √(D(1−D))
formula.plainEn: Rectangular duty electrical std is peak power times √(D(1−D))

children.titleZh: 合成：E_cyc = P · D · T 周期注入能量
children.titleEn: Compose: E_cyc = P · D · T cycle injection energy
children.bodyZh: 矩形周期电学能量 P·D·T。算例 P=100、D=0.5、T=0.01 → E=0.5 J；桥接 S24u cycleEnergyPowerJ / periodEnergyResidual。
children.bodyEn: Rectangular cycle energy P·D·T; sample 100·0.5·0.01=0.5 J; bridges S24u cycleEnergyPowerJ / periodEnergyResidual.

formula.plainZh: 周期注入能量由峰值功率、占空比与周期三者合成
formula.plainEn: Cycle injection energy composes peak power, duty cycle, and period

children.titleZh: L0：热阻 / 结温教学叶子
children.bodyZh: 教学可用单支路 Rθ 与阶跃温升演示；不计入 engineering DoD。完整多层 Foster / multi-pulse duty / Dragomir residual 归 solvers-thermal（S24 残差 tip 含 B32–B45 / S24bl landed，smoke≠eng DoD）。
children.bodyEn: Teaching single-branch Rθ demos allowed; eng multilayer Foster / multi-pulse duty / Dragomir residual lives in solvers-thermal (S24 residual tip incl. B32–B45 / S24bl landed; smoke≠eng DoD).

titleZh: LBM D3Q19 流体（工程 kind）
summaryZh: W-Sim BuiltinJobKind lbm-d3q19：格子 Boltzmann D3Q19 工程路径；教学落到 BGK 粘度、格子权与 D2Q9 顶盖方腔。
summaryEn: W-Sim kind lbm-d3q19: lattice-Boltzmann D3Q19 path; drills to BGK viscosity, weights, D2Q9 lid-driven cavity.

explainRoot.bodyZh: 顶层工程计算方法：介观分布函数 f_i 经 collide–stream 演化，低 Mach 下逼近不可压 Navier–Stokes。工程三维为 D3Q19；二维教学常用 D2Q9 顶盖驱动方腔。数值实现归 @w-sim/solvers-lbm。
explainRoot.bodyEn: Mesoscopic f_i collide–stream approximates NS at low Ma; eng D3Q19, teaching D2Q9 cavity; owned by @w-sim/solvers-lbm.

children.titleZh: 原理：BGK 碰撞与流淌
children.bodyZh: 单松弛 BGK：f* = f − (f − f^eq)/τ；随后 f_i(x+e_i, t+1) ← f*_i(x,t)。τ 控制粘性；stream 沿离散速度迁移守恒质量/动量（无外力时）。
children.bodyEn: BGK: f* = f − (f−f^eq)/τ then stream along e_i; τ sets viscosity; mass/momentum conserved without force.

children.titleZh: 基础式：ν = c_s² (τ − 1/2)
children.bodyZh: 格子单位下运动粘度。D2Q9/D3Q19 常取 c_s² = 1/3。要求 τ > 1/2（ν>0）；τ 过近 1/2 数值噪声大，过大则过度耗散。
children.bodyEn: Lattice kinematic viscosity; c_s²=1/3 on D2Q9/D3Q19; need τ>1/2.

formula.plainZh: 运动粘度等于格子声速平方乘以松弛时间减二分之一
formula.plainEn: Kinematic viscosity is lattice sound-speed squared times (τ − 1/2)

children.titleZh: 基础：c_s² = 1/3
children.bodyZh: 标准 D2Q9 / D3Q19 等温格子声速平方。宏观压强 p = c_s² ρ；低 Mach |u| ≪ c_s 时才逼近不可压 NS。
children.bodyEn: Standard D2Q9/D3Q19 isothermal c_s²; p=c_s²ρ; low-Ma needed for incompressible NS.

formula.plainZh: D2Q9/D3Q19 标准格子声速平方为三分之一
formula.plainEn: Standard D2Q9/D3Q19 lattice sound-speed squared is 1/3

children.titleZh: 基础式：f* = f − (f − f_eq)/τ
children.bodyZh: 单方向 BGK 碰撞。τ=1 时 f* = f_eq（一步松弛到平衡）。外力可在碰撞后叠加 Guo 等格式。
children.bodyEn: Per-direction BGK; τ=1 → f*=f_eq in one step; forces via Guo-style schemes.

formula.plainZh: BGK 碰撞后分布向局部平衡态松弛
formula.plainEn: BGK post-collision distribution relaxes toward local equilibrium

children.titleZh: 原理：宏观矩与平衡态
children.bodyZh: 密度 ρ = Σ f_i，动量 ρu = Σ f_i e_i；f^eq 由 ρ、u 与权 w_i 构造，使 0–2 阶矩匹配可压/弱可压 NS 连续极限。
children.bodyEn: ρ=Σf_i, ρu=Σf_i e_i; f^eq(ρ,u,w) matches low-order moments for NS limit.

children.titleZh: 基础式：ρ = Σ f_i（D2Q9 权分解）
children.titleEn: Foundation: ρ = Σ f_i (D2Q9 weight split)
children.bodyZh: 静止均匀平衡 f_i = ρ w_i 时，ρ 由 rest/cardinal/diagonal 三组恢复。D3Q19 同理扩展面心/体心方向。
children.bodyEn: At rest f_i=ρ w_i; ρ recovered from rest/cardinal/diagonal groups; D3Q19 adds face/body sets.

vars.f2: 对角方向单支分布（=ρ w_diag）

formula.plainZh: 宏观密度等于各离散方向分布函数之和
formula.plainEn: Macroscopic density is the sum of discrete-direction populations

children.titleZh: 基础：D2Q9 权求和 = 1
children.bodyZh: w0=4/9，4 个轴向 w=1/9，4 个对角 w=1/36；Σ w_i = 1 保证均匀静止态矩正确。D3Q19 权集不同但同样归一。
children.bodyEn: D2Q9: 4/9 + 4×1/9 + 4×1/36 = 1; D3Q19 uses another normalized set.

formula.plainZh: D2Q9 离散速度权之和必须为 1
formula.plainEn: D2Q9 discrete-velocity weights must sum to 1

children.titleZh: 假设与有效域
children.bodyZh: 低 Mach、弱可压/等温 BGK；高 Re 需足够分辨率或湍流模型。强可压、多相、非牛顿需扩展碰撞/力项。工程 smoke 覆盖质量守恒、粘度标定与腔流对称。
children.bodyEn: Low-Ma isothermal BGK; high-Re needs resolution/turbulence; multiphase/non-Newtonian need extensions.

children.titleZh: 原理：D2Q9 顶盖驱动方腔
children.bodyZh: 经典 2D 基准：顶盖 U_lid、其余无滑移。Re = U L / ν 标定流态；稳态主涡/角涡位置与 Ghia 等参考对比。工程 D3Q19 可推广为 3D 腔，教学以 D2Q9 为主。
children.bodyEn: Classic 2D benchmark: lid U, no-slip walls; Re=UL/ν; compare vortices to Ghia-class refs; eng may 3D-extend.

children.titleZh: 基础式：Re = U L / ν
children.bodyZh: 顶盖速度 U、腔边长 L（格子数）、运动粘度 ν 定义雷诺数。教学常用 Re~100；工程扫参可更高并检查网格收敛。
children.bodyEn: Lid speed U, cavity size L, viscosity ν define Re; teaching often Re~100.

formula.plainZh: 方腔雷诺数等于顶盖速度乘边长再除以运动粘度
formula.plainEn: Cavity Reynolds number is lid speed times length over kinematic viscosity

children.titleZh: 基础：由 Re 反推 τ
children.bodyZh: ν = U L / Re，再 τ = ν/c_s² + 1/2。给定 U、L、Re 可唯一确定 BGK 松弛（固定 c_s²=1/3）。
children.bodyEn: ν=UL/Re then τ=ν/c_s²+1/2; fixes BGK relaxation for given U,L,Re.

formula.plainZh: 松弛时间由运动粘度与格子声速平方反推得到
formula.plainEn: Relaxation time is recovered from viscosity and lattice sound-speed squared
