children.titleZh: 合成：ν = c_s² (τ − 1/2)
children.bodyZh: 把松弛时间与格子声速合成运动粘度。BGK 粘性合同的核心；工程标定常由此反推 τ。
children.bodyEn: Composes τ and c_s² into kinematic viscosity; core BGK viscosity contract.

formula.plainZh: 合成运动粘度等于格子声速平方乘松弛时间减二分之一
formula.plainEn: Composed kinematic viscosity is c_s² times (τ − 1/2)

children.titleZh: 合成链：Re → ν → τ
children.bodyEn: Cavity chain: ν=UL/Re then τ=ν/c_s²+1/2; sample yields τ=1.

formula.plainZh: 由雷诺数与顶盖参数反推 BGK 松弛时间
formula.plainEn: BGK relaxation time is recovered from Reynolds number and lid parameters

children.titleZh: 合成：D2Q9 权归一 Σ w_i = 1
children.titleEn: Compose: D2Q9 weight normalization Σ w_i = 1
children.bodyZh: 权与矩合成的前提：静止+轴+对角权之和为 1，保证均匀静止平衡态 ρ 正确。
children.bodyEn: Weight/moment compose requires Σw=1 so rest equilibrium recovers ρ.

formula.plainZh: D2Q9 权归一合成要求离散速度权之和为 1
formula.plainEn: D2Q9 weight compose requires discrete-velocity weights sum to 1

children.titleZh: 合成：方腔 Re = U L / ν
children.titleEn: Compose: cavity Re = U L / ν
children.bodyZh: 把顶盖速度、腔边长与 BGK 粘度合成雷诺数，标定腔流 KPI 与参考解对比域。
children.bodyEn: Composes lid speed, size, and BGK viscosity into Re for cavity KPI domain.

formula.plainZh: 方腔雷诺数由顶盖速度、边长与运动粘度合成
formula.plainEn: Cavity Reynolds number composes lid speed, length, and viscosity

children.titleZh: 合成：宏观压 p = c_s² ρ
children.titleEn: Compose: macroscopic pressure p = c_s² ρ
children.bodyZh: 把格子声速平方与密度矩合成等温状态方程 p=c_s²ρ；低 Ma 弱可压极限下梯度 −∇p 进入动量方程。算例 c_s²=1/3、ρ=1 → p=1/3。
children.bodyEn: Composes c_s² with density moment into isothermal p=c_s²ρ; sample p=1/3.

formula.plainZh: 等温格子宏观压强等于声速平方乘密度
formula.plainEn: Isothermal lattice pressure is sound-speed squared times density

children.titleZh: 合成：BGK 碰撞 f* = f − (f − f_eq)/τ
children.titleEn: Compose: BGK collision f* = f − (f − f_eq)/τ
children.bodyZh: 把分布、局部平衡与松弛时间合成碰撞后种群；与 stream 合成为 collide–stream 步进。τ=1 时一步到平衡。算例 f=0.4、f_eq=0.25、τ=1 → f*=0.25。
children.bodyEn: Composes f, f_eq, τ into post-collision f*; with stream yields collide–stream; sample τ=1 → f*=f_eq.

formula.plainZh: BGK 碰撞后分布由当前种群向局部平衡态按松弛时间合成
formula.plainEn: BGK post-collision population composes current f toward local equilibrium by τ

children.titleZh: 合成：ν = U L / Re（由 Re 标定）
children.titleEn: Compose: ν = U L / Re from Re calibration
children.bodyZh: 腔流标定链的前半：由目标雷诺数与顶盖参数反推运动粘度，再进入 τ=ν/c_s²+1/2。算例 U=0.1、L=100、Re=60 → ν=1/6。
children.bodyEn: Front half of cavity chain: ν=UL/Re from target Re; sample ν=1/6.

formula.plainZh: 运动粘度由顶盖速度、腔边长与目标雷诺数反推合成
formula.plainEn: Kinematic viscosity composes from lid speed, cavity size, and target Reynolds number

children.titleZh: 合成：密度矩 ρ = Σ f_i（权分解）
children.titleEn: Compose: density moment ρ = Σ f_i (weight split)
children.bodyZh: 把 rest/cardinal/diagonal 三组分布合成宏观密度；静止均匀平衡 f_i=ρ w_i 时恢复 ρ=1。连接 principle「矩」与 BGK 平衡构造。
children.bodyEn: Composes rest/cardinal/diagonal populations into ρ; rest equilibrium recovers ρ=1.

formula.plainZh: 宏观密度由各离散方向分布函数求和合成
formula.plainEn: Macroscopic density composes as the sum of discrete-direction populations

children.titleZh: 合成：标准格子 c_s² = 1/3
children.bodyZh: D2Q9/D3Q19 等温格子声速平方合同；与权/矩、p=c_s²ρ、ν(τ) 全链共用。算例常数 1/3。
children.bodyEn: Standard D2Q9/D3Q19 isothermal c_s² contract shared by weights, p, and ν(τ); sample 1/3.

formula.plainZh: 标准 D2Q9/D3Q19 格子声速平方合成为三分之一
formula.plainEn: Standard D2Q9/D3Q19 lattice sound-speed squared composes as one third

children.titleZh: 合成：力驱动通道 G 反演 G = 8 ν u_max / H²
children.titleEn: Compose: force-channel G recovery G = 8 ν u_max / H²
children.bodyZh: 平面 Poiseuille 通道：均匀体力 G、半高/高度 H 的无滑移平行板，峰值 u_max = G H²/(8ν)。工程 smoke 常由测得 u_max 反演 G 校验力项与粘度合同。算例 ν=1/6、u_max=0.1、H=50 → G=8νu_max/H²。
children.bodyEn: Plane Poiseuille: body force G, height H → u_max=G H²/(8ν); recover G from peak velocity to check force/viscosity contract; sample ν=1/6, u_max=0.1, H=50.

vars.G: 单位质量体力（格子单位）

formula.plainZh: 力驱动通道体力由峰值速度、高度与运动粘度反演合成
formula.plainEn: Force-channel body force recovers from peak velocity, height, and kinematic viscosity

children.titleZh: 合成：Poiseuille 峰值 u_max = G H² / (8 ν)
children.titleEn: Compose: Poiseuille peak u_max = G H² / (8 ν)
children.bodyZh: 与 G 反演对偶：给定体力与粘度合成解析峰值，对照 LBM 稳态剖面中心速度（force-channel eng residual）。算例 G=8ν·0.1/H²、ν=1/6、H=50 → u_max=0.1。
children.bodyEn: Dual of G recovery: analytic peak from G,H,ν vs LBM centerline; sample yields u_max=0.1.

vars.G: 单位质量体力（格子单位）

formula.plainZh: 力驱动平行板通道峰值速度由体力、高度与粘度合成
formula.plainEn: Force-driven parallel-plate peak velocity composes from body force, height, and viscosity

children.titleZh: 合成链：Ma = Re ν / (L c_s)（Ma–ν 链）
children.titleEn: Compose chain: Ma = Re ν / (L c_s) (Mach–ν link)
children.bodyZh: 把 Re 标定、运动粘度与格子声速合成 Mach：U=Re ν/L，Ma=U/c_s。低 Ma 与 ν(τ) 同链约束顶盖/通道特征速度。算例 Re=60、ν=1/6、L=100、c_s²=1/3 → Ma=0.1/√(1/3)，与 lbm-compose-mach 一致。
children.bodyEn: Links Re, ν, and c_s into Ma: U=Re ν/L, Ma=U/c_s; sample matches lid Ma≈0.173.

formula.plainZh: Mach 数由雷诺数、运动粘度、特征长度与格子声速合成
formula.plainEn: Mach number composes from Reynolds number, viscosity, length, and lattice sound speed

children.titleZh: 合成：Guo 力项预因子 (1 − 1/(2τ))
children.bodyZh: Guo 外力格式离散方向力 F_i 的公共预因子 pref=1−1/(2τ)，保证半时间动量修正与 BGK 粘性一致；与 force-channel 体力注入同核。算例 τ=1 → pref=1/2。
children.bodyEn: Guo discrete force shares pref=1−1/(2τ) for half-step momentum consistency with BGK; sample τ=1 → 1/2.

formula.plainZh: Guo 外力预因子由松弛时间合成以保证动量修正与粘性一致
formula.plainEn: Guo forcing prefactor composes from relaxation time for momentum–viscosity consistency

children.titleZh: 合成：截面平均 u_mean = (2/3) u_max
children.bodyZh: 平面 Poiseuille 抛物线剖面：平均速度为峰值的 2/3，进入 Re=u_mean D_h/ν 与 f·Re 标定。算例 u_max=0.1 → u_mean=1/15。
children.bodyEn: Plane Poiseuille parabola: mean is 2/3 of peak; feeds Re and f·Re; sample u_max=0.1 → u_mean=1/15.

formula.plainZh: 力驱动平行板通道平均速度为峰值速度的三分之二
formula.plainEn: Force-driven parallel-plate mean velocity is two thirds of the peak

children.titleZh: 合成：D3Q19 权归一 w0+6w1+12w2 = 1
children.bodyZh: 工程三维 D3Q19：静止 w0=1/3、6 个面心 w1=1/18、12 个棱边 w2=1/36；Σw=1 保证均匀静止平衡态 ρ 正确。与 D2Q9 权归一并列，桥接 solvers-lbm 工程轨。
children.bodyEn: Eng D3Q19: rest 1/3, 6 face 1/18, 12 edge 1/36; Σw=1 for rest equilibrium; pairs with D2Q9 weight compose.

formula.plainZh: D3Q19 离散速度权之和必须合成为 1
formula.plainEn: D3Q19 discrete-velocity weights must compose to sum 1

children.titleZh: 合成：τ = ν/c_s² + 1/2（由粘度）
children.bodyZh: ν(τ) 的对偶反演：给定运动粘度与格子声速平方合成 BGK 松弛。算例 ν=1/6、c_s²=1/3 → τ=1；与 lbm-compose-nu-tau / tau-match 合同。
children.bodyEn: Dual of ν(τ): recover τ from ν and c_s²; sample τ=1; contracts nu-tau / tau-match.

formula.plainZh: 松弛时间由运动粘度与格子声速平方反推合成
formula.plainEn: Relaxation time composes from kinematic viscosity and lattice sound-speed squared

children.titleZh: 合成：平行板水力直径 D_h = 2 H
children.titleEn: Compose: parallel-plate hydraulic diameter D_h = 2 H
children.bodyZh: 力驱动通道 Re 与 f·Re 标定用水力直径：无限宽平行板 D_h=2H。算例 H=50 → D_h=100，与腔边长量级对齐便于对照。
children.bodyEn: Force-channel Re and f·Re use D_h=2H for infinite parallel plates; sample H=50 → D_h=100.

formula.plainZh: 平行板通道水力直径合成为高度的两倍
formula.plainEn: Parallel-plate hydraulic diameter composes as twice the channel height

children.titleZh: 合成：通道 Re = u_mean D_h / ν
children.titleEn: Compose: channel Re = u_mean D_h / ν
children.bodyZh: 力驱动通道雷诺数：截面平均速度、水力直径与粘度合成。算例 u_mean=(2/3)·0.1、D_h=100、ν=1/6 → Re=40；进入 f·Re=24 时 f=0.6。
children.bodyEn: Force-channel Re from mean speed, D_h, ν; sample Re=40; with f·Re=24 → f=0.6.

formula.plainZh: 力驱动通道雷诺数由平均速度、水力直径与运动粘度合成
formula.plainEn: Force-channel Reynolds number composes mean velocity, hydraulic diameter, and viscosity

children.titleZh: 合成：壁剪 τ_w = ρ G H / 2（力平衡）
children.titleEn: Compose: wall shear τ_w = ρ G H / 2 (force balance)
children.bodyZh: 稳态平行板：两侧壁剪平衡体力 ρ G H（单位宽度、单位长度）。算例 ρ=1、G=8ν u_max/H²、H=50、ν=1/6、u_max=0.1 → τ_w=G H/2。
children.bodyEn: Steady parallel plates: 2 τ_w = ρ G H per unit width/length; sample ρ=1, Poiseuille G → τ_w=G H/2.

formula.plainZh: 力驱动通道壁面剪应力由密度、体力与高度力平衡合成
formula.plainEn: Force-channel wall shear composes from density, body force, and height via force balance

children.titleZh: 合成：压降等价 −∂p/∂x = ρ G
children.bodyZh: 均匀体力 G 与恒定压降在不可压极限下等价驱动通道。算例 ρ=1、G=8ν u_max/H² → |dp/dx|=ρ G，连接 p=c_s²ρ 弱可压解释与 force-channel 工程。
children.bodyEn: Uniform body force G ≡ constant −∇p at incompressible limit; sample |dp/dx|=ρG; links p=c_s²ρ and force-channel eng.

vars.dpdx: 等价压降梯度幅值（格子单位）

formula.plainZh: 力驱动通道等价压降梯度等于密度乘单位质量体力
formula.plainEn: Force-channel equivalent pressure gradient equals density times body force per mass

children.titleZh: 合成：Guo 半步速度 u = (j + F/2) / ρ
children.titleEn: Compose: Guo half-step velocity u = (j + F/2) / ρ
children.bodyZh: Guo 外力格式宏观速度用半时间动量修正：F=ρG 时 u=(j+F/2)/ρ，与 pref=1−1/(2τ) 同核保证二阶准确。算例 j=0.09、F=0.02、ρ=1 → u=0.1。
children.bodyEn: Guo macro velocity uses half-step momentum: u=(j+F/2)/ρ with F=ρG; pairs with pref; sample j=0.09,F=0.02,ρ=1 → u=0.1.

vars.j: 分布一阶矩 Σ f_i e_i

formula.plainZh: Guo 格式宏观速度由动量矩与半步体力修正合成
formula.plainEn: Guo macroscopic velocity composes momentum moment with half-step force correction

children.titleZh: 合成：格子声速 c_s = √c_s²
children.bodyZh: 由 c_s²=1/3 合成 c_s，进入 Ma=U/c_s 与低 Ma 闸门。算例 c_s²=1/3 → c_s=√(1/3)。
children.bodyEn: Composes c_s from c_s²=1/3 for Ma=U/c_s and low-Ma gate; sample √(1/3).

formula.plainZh: 格子声速等于声速平方的平方根
formula.plainEn: Lattice sound speed is the square root of sound-speed squared

children.titleZh: 合成：Darcy 摩阻 f = 24 / Re
children.bodyZh: 由 f·Re=24 反演层流摩阻。算例通道 Re=40 → f=0.6；与 lbm-compose-Re-channel / f-re 对偶。
children.bodyEn: Invert laminar f from f·Re=24; sample Re=40 → f=0.6; dual of Re-channel / f-re.

formula.plainZh: 层流平行板 Darcy 摩阻等于 24 除以通道雷诺数
formula.plainEn: Laminar parallel-plate Darcy friction is 24 divided by channel Reynolds number

children.titleZh: 合成：体力密度 F = ρ G
children.titleEn: Compose: force density F = ρ G
children.bodyZh: 单位体积力 F 与单位质量体力 G 由密度合成；进入 Guo 半步 u 与离散力 F_i。算例 ρ=1、G=8ν u_max/H² → F=G。
children.bodyEn: Volume force F=ρG feeds Guo half-step u and discrete F_i; sample ρ=1 → F=G.

formula.plainZh: 体力密度等于宏观密度乘单位质量体力
formula.plainEn: Force density equals macroscopic density times body force per mass

children.titleZh: 合成：D3Q19 离散速度数 Q = 19
children.bodyZh: 工程 kind 拓扑合同：1 静止 + 6 面心 + 12 棱边 = 19 个离散速度；与 D2Q9（Q=9）教学轨对照。算例常数 19。
children.bodyEn: Eng kind topology: 1 rest + 6 face + 12 edge = 19 velocities; contrasts teaching D2Q9 Q=9; sample 19.

formula.plainZh: D3Q19 离散速度数由静止、面心与棱边方向合成得 19
formula.plainEn: D3Q19 discrete-velocity count composes rest, face, and edge directions to 19

children.titleZh: 合成：G = (−∂p/∂x) / ρ（压降反演体力）
children.bodyZh: 压降驱动与体力驱动对偶：由等价压降梯度反演 G。算例 dpdx=ρG 匹配时 G=dpdx/ρ；与 lbm-compose-dpdx 合同。
children.bodyEn: Dual of pressure–force equivalence: recover G from |∇p|; sample matches dpdx compose.

vars.dpdx: 压降梯度幅值（格子单位）

formula.plainZh: 单位质量体力由等价压降梯度与密度反演合成
formula.plainEn: Body force per mass recovers from equivalent pressure gradient over density

children.titleZh: 合成：静止平衡 f_eq,0 = w0 ρ
children.titleEn: Compose: rest equilibrium f_eq,0 = w0 ρ
children.bodyZh: u=0 时平衡态 f_eq,i=w_i ρ；静止支路用 D2Q9 w0=4/9。算例 ρ=1 → f_eq,0=4/9；连接矩恢复与 BGK 碰撞。
children.bodyEn: At rest f_eq,i=w_i ρ; rest branch uses D2Q9 w0=4/9; sample ρ=1 → 4/9; links moments and BGK.

formula.plainZh: 静止平衡分布等于静止权乘宏观密度
formula.plainEn: Rest equilibrium population is rest weight times macroscopic density

children.titleZh: 合成：Guo 轴向力支 F_i ∝ pref w (e·F)/c_s²
children.titleEn: Compose: Guo cardinal force branch F_i ∝ pref w (e·F)/c_s²
children.bodyZh: Guo 离散力一阶支：沿轴向 e·F=|F| 时 F_i = pref · w · (e·F)/c_s²（略二阶 uF 项教学）。算例 pref=1/2、w=1/9、F=0.02、c_s²=1/3 → F_i=pref·w·F/cs2。
children.bodyEn: Guo first-order cardinal branch F_i=pref·w·(e·F)/c_s² (omit uF term for teaching); sample pref=1/2,w=1/9,F=0.02,cs2=1/3.

vars.F: 体力密度（与 e 对齐分量）

formula.plainZh: Guo 轴向离散力由预因子、权、体力与声速平方合成
formula.plainEn: Guo cardinal discrete force composes prefactor, weight, force density, and sound-speed squared

children.titleZh: 合成：p_bb = f_bulk · Re_bulk（匹配 bulk 积）
children.titleEn: Compose: p_bb = f_bulk · Re_bulk (matched bulk product)
children.bodyZh: 力通道 f·Re 四积之一：bulk 摩阻 × bulk 雷诺。层流金标 p_bb→12。算例 f_b=1.2、Re_b=10 → 12；桥接 S19ba/S19bb quadruple products。
children.bodyEn: One of four f·Re products: bulk friction × bulk Re; laminar gold →12; sample 1.2×10=12; bridges S19ba/S19bb.

formula.plainZh: 匹配 bulk 摩阻雷诺积等于 bulk 摩阻乘 bulk 雷诺数
formula.plainEn: Matched bulk friction–Reynolds product is bulk friction times bulk Reynolds number

children.titleZh: 合成：p_pp = f_peak · Re_peak（匹配 peak 积）
children.titleEn: Compose: p_pp = f_peak · Re_peak (matched peak product)
children.bodyZh: 四积对偶：peak 摩阻 × peak 雷诺。金标 p_pp→12。算例 f_p=0.8、Re_p=15 → 12；与 p_bb 匹配时 GM=HM=AM=12。
children.bodyEn: Dual peak product f_peak×Re_peak; gold →12; sample 0.8×15=12; matched with p_bb yields AM=GM=HM=12.

formula.plainZh: 匹配 peak 摩阻雷诺积等于 peak 摩阻乘 peak 雷诺数
formula.plainEn: Matched peak friction–Reynolds product is peak friction times peak Reynolds number

children.titleZh: 合成：p_bp = f_bulk · Re_peak（交叉 bulk–peak 积）
children.titleEn: Compose: p_bp = f_bulk · Re_peak (cross bulk–peak product)
children.bodyZh: 交叉四积：bulk 摩阻 × peak 雷诺。算例 1.2×15=18；与 p_pb 配对进入 AM/GM/HM 梯。桥接 S19bb cross means。
children.bodyEn: Cross product bulk friction × peak Re; sample 18; pairs with p_pb into AM/GM/HM ladder; bridges S19bb.

formula.plainZh: 交叉 bulk–peak 摩阻雷诺积等于 bulk 摩阻乘 peak 雷诺数
formula.plainEn: Cross bulk–peak friction–Reynolds product is bulk friction times peak Reynolds number

children.titleZh: 合成：p_pb = f_peak · Re_bulk（交叉 peak–bulk 积）
children.titleEn: Compose: p_pb = f_peak · Re_bulk (cross peak–bulk product)
children.bodyZh: 交叉四积对偶：peak 摩阻 × bulk 雷诺。算例 0.8×10=8；p_bp·p_pb=144=12·12 与匹配 GM 合同。
children.bodyEn: Dual cross product peak friction × bulk Re; sample 8; p_bp·p_pb=144=12·12 matches matched GM identity.

formula.plainZh: 交叉 peak–bulk 摩阻雷诺积等于 peak 摩阻乘 bulk 雷诺数
formula.plainEn: Cross peak–bulk friction–Reynolds product is peak friction times bulk Reynolds number

children.titleZh: 合成：算术均值 AM = (a + b) / 2
children.bodyZh: S19bb 均值梯顶端：交叉积对 (p_bp, p_pb) 的算术均值。算例 a=18、b=8 → AM=13；金标 12 时 AM 残差 |13−12|/12=1/12。
children.bodyEn: Top of S19bb mean ladder: AM of cross products; sample 18,8 → 13; gold 12 → residual 1/12.

formula.plainZh: 算术均值等于两积之和的一半
formula.plainEn: Arithmetic mean is half the sum of the two products

children.titleZh: 合成：几何均值 GM = √(a · b)
children.bodyZh: S19ba/S19bb 几何层：交叉积对几何均值。算例 √(18·8)=12；与匹配 √(p_bb·p_pp) 代数同构时 GM 恒等。
children.bodyEn: Geometric layer: √(a·b); sample √(18·8)=12; algebraically matches √(p_bb·p_pp) when products form a rectangle.

formula.plainZh: 几何均值等于两积之积的平方根
formula.plainEn: Geometric mean is the square root of the product of the two products

children.titleZh: 合成：调和均值 HM = 2 a b / (a + b)
children.titleEn: Compose: harmonic mean HM = 2 a b / (a + b)
children.bodyZh: S19bb 调和层：H(a,b)=2ab/(a+b)。算例 a=18、b=8 → HM=288/26≈11.077；完成 AM≥GM≥HM 梯。
children.bodyEn: Harmonic layer H=2ab/(a+b); sample 18,8 → 288/26; completes AM≥GM≥HM ladder.

formula.plainZh: 调和均值等于两倍两积之积除以两积之和
formula.plainEn: Harmonic mean is twice the product of the two values over their sum

children.titleZh: 合成：匹配算术均值 AM_m = (p_bb + p_pp) / 2
children.titleEn: Compose: matched arithmetic mean AM_m = (p_bb + p_pp) / 2
children.bodyZh: 匹配积对算术均值；p_bb=p_pp=12 时 AM_m=12。算例 12、12 → 12；与交叉 AM 对偶闭合 S19bb AM 封装。
children.bodyEn: Matched-pair AM; sample 12,12 → 12; dual of cross AM closes S19bb AM packaging.

formula.plainZh: 匹配算术均值等于 bulk 与 peak 摩阻雷诺积之和的一半
formula.plainEn: Matched arithmetic mean is half the sum of bulk and peak friction–Reynolds products

children.titleZh: 合成：匹配几何均值 GM_m = √(p_bb · p_pp)
children.titleEn: Compose: matched geometric mean GM_m = √(p_bb · p_pp)
children.bodyZh: S19bd 匹配均值三元组：GM_m=√(p_bb·p_pp)。算例 p_bb=p_pp=12 → GM_m=12；与交叉 GM 代数同构时 dual→0。桥接 means dual packaging。
children.bodyEn: S19bd matched means triad GM_m=√(p_bb·p_pp); sample 12,12 → 12; dual→0 when isomorphic to cross GM; bridges means dual packaging.

formula.plainZh: 匹配几何均值等于 bulk 与 peak 摩阻雷诺积之积的平方根
formula.plainEn: Matched geometric mean is the square root of the product of bulk and peak friction–Reynolds products

children.titleZh: 合成：匹配调和均值 HM_m = 2 p_bb p_pp / (p_bb + p_pp)
children.titleEn: Compose: matched harmonic mean HM_m = 2 p_bb p_pp / (p_bb + p_pp)
children.bodyZh: S19bd 匹配调和：HM_m=2 p_bb p_pp/(p_bb+p_pp)。算例 12、12 → 12；与交叉 HM 配对进入 means dual。
children.bodyEn: S19bd matched harmonic HM_m; sample 12,12 → 12; pairs with cross HM into means dual.

formula.plainZh: 匹配调和均值等于两倍 bulk·peak 积除以 bulk 与 peak 积之和
formula.plainEn: Matched harmonic mean is twice the bulk·peak product over the sum of bulk and peak products

children.titleZh: L0：D2Q9 方腔 / Atlas 教学叶子
children.bodyZh: 教学可用二维 D2Q9 顶盖方腔与 WebGPU/Atlas 孵化演示；不计入 engineering DoD。完整 D3Q19 与工程边界归 @w-sim/solvers-lbm。
children.bodyEn: Teaching D2Q9 lid-driven cavity allowed; eng D3Q19 lives in solvers-lbm.

summaryZh: 能量转换边的效率定义：有用输出 / 输入（η≤1 类过程的第一定律闸门）。
summaryEn: Efficiency as useful out / in (first-law style gate for η≤1 processes).

explainRoot.bodyZh: 顶层 KPI：用输出与输入功率（或能量）定义效率。
explainRoot.bodyEn: Top KPI: efficiency from useful output and input.

children.titleZh: 原理：能量守恒边界
children.bodyZh: 对被动耗散型转换，η 不应超过 1；COP 类可大于 1 但不叫 η。
children.bodyEn: Passive dissipative conversions: η ≰ 1; COP may exceed 1.

children.titleZh: 基础定义：η = P_out / P_in
children.bodyZh: 需标明输出/输入的物理口径（电、光、热…）。
children.bodyEn: Declare which powers count as out/in.

formula.plainZh: 效率等于有用输出功率除以输入功率
formula.plainEn: Efficiency is useful output power over input power

children.titleZh: 知识层：conversion.efficiency claim
children.bodyZh: Knowledge DB claim kind `conversion.efficiency` 承载点值/区间与条件；Controversies 可挂多解释。
children.bodyEn: Claim kind conversion.efficiency holds point/range + conditions; Controversies holds multi-explain.

summaryZh: W-Sim BuiltinJobKind acoustics-3d：线性声学平面波 / 时域推进工程路径；教学可落到波速与阻抗基础式。
summaryEn: W-Sim kind acoustics-3d: linear acoustics plane-wave path; drills to sound speed and impedance.

explainRoot.bodyZh: 顶层工程计算方法：在均匀介质中推进线性声波（平面波/弱散射量级），输出压力/质点速度场与传播 KPI。数值实现归 @w-sim/solvers-acoustics。
explainRoot.bodyEn: Advances linear sound in uniform media; owned by @w-sim/solvers-acoustics.

children.titleZh: 原理：线性平面波
children.bodyZh: 小扰动下压力与密度扰动满足一维波动方程；单色平面波解 p ∝ Re{ exp(j(ωt − k·x)) }，色散关系 ω = c |k|（无耗散）。
children.bodyEn: Small-signal pressure obeys the wave equation; monochromatic plane waves satisfy ω = c |k|.

children.titleZh: 基础式：声速 c = √(K/ρ)
children.bodyZh: 体积模量 K 与质量密度 ρ 决定小振幅声速。理想气体常写 c = √(γ P/ρ)。要求 K>0、ρ>0。
children.bodyEn: Bulk modulus K and density ρ set small-signal sound speed; ideal gas c=√(γP/ρ).

formula.plainZh: 声速等于体积模量除以密度再开方
formula.plainEn: Sound speed is the square root of bulk modulus over density

children.titleZh: 基础式：特征阻抗 Z = ρ c
children.bodyZh: 正向行波中 p / v_n ≈ Z。界面反射/透射由两侧 Z 失配决定；工程边界常给吸声或硬壁近似。
children.bodyEn: For progressive waves p/v_n ≈ Z; impedance mismatch sets reflection.

formula.plainZh: 特征阻抗等于密度乘声速
formula.plainEn: Characteristic impedance is density times sound speed

children.titleZh: 假设与有效域
children.bodyZh: 线性、各向同性、弱粘滞耗散可忽略的量级；大振幅、空化、强剪切边界层需更高阶模型。工程 smoke 覆盖均匀介质平面波相位与能量流符号。
children.bodyEn: Linear isotropic media; large amplitude / cavitation need higher-order models.

children.titleZh: 原理：波动方程与时域推进
children.bodyZh: 从连续方程 + 动量方程 + 状态关系消去得到 ∂²p/∂t² = c² ∇²p。时域格式（FDTD/有限体积等）在 CFL 约束下推进。
children.bodyEn: Continuity + momentum + EOS → wave equation; time schemes march under CFL.

children.titleZh: 基础：波数 k = ω / c
children.bodyZh: 无色散介质中波长 λ = 2π/k = 2π c / ω；网格分辨率常按每波长点数约束。
children.bodyEn: Non-dispersive: λ = 2π c / ω; mesh resolution often points-per-wavelength.

formula.plainZh: 波数等于角频率除以声速
formula.plainEn: Wavenumber is angular frequency over sound speed

children.titleZh: 基础：周期 T = 2π / ω
children.bodyZh: 单色波时间周期与角频率互逆：T = 2π/ω = 1/f。与 k=ω/c 合成为相速 c = λ/T。
children.bodyEn: Monochromatic period T=2π/ω=1/f; with k=ω/c yields phase speed c=λ/T.

formula.plainZh: 声波周期等于二π除以角频率
formula.plainEn: Acoustic period is 2π over angular frequency

children.titleZh: 基础：1D 声学 CFL 上界 dt_max ≈ dx / c
children.titleEn: Foundation: 1D acoustic CFL bound dt_max ≈ dx / c
children.bodyZh: 显式时域推进在 1D 量级要求信息在一个时间步内不超过一格：dt ≤ dx/c。多维再乘 1/√d 量级因子；工程 compose 用安全比 s=dt/dt_max。
children.bodyEn: Explicit 1D CFL: dt ≤ dx/c; multi-D adds ~1/√d; compose uses safety ratio s=dt/dt_max.

formula.plainZh: 一维声学 CFL 上界时间步约等于网格间距除以声速
formula.plainEn: One-dimensional acoustic CFL max time step is grid spacing over sound speed

children.titleZh: 工程包：solvers-acoustics
children.bodyZh: JobKind `acoustics-3d` 由 @w-sim/solvers-acoustics 拥有；经 kind-matrix 与 lab-kit 登记（ABC energy iuda-dense multi-CFL residual S28cj + juda-dense multi-CFL residual S28ck landed 等 fixture）。**smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation**。
children.bodyEn: Owned by @w-sim/solvers-acoustics; kind-matrix + lab-kit fixtures including ABC energy iuda-dense multi-CFL residual S28cj + juda-dense multi-CFL residual S28ck landed; smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation.

children.titleZh: 合成视角：介质 (c,Z) ∘ 波动推进 ≈ 声学方法
children.titleEn: Compose: medium (c,Z) ∘ wave march ≈ acoustics method
children.bodyZh: 科技树语义：更基础的「声速/阻抗 / 波数/周期」与「时域/频域波动推进 / iuda-dense multi-CFL residual / juda-dense multi-CFL residual」合成应在等价域复现顶层声学 KPI（平面波 p/v=Z、质点速度反演、强度、I=u·c 能流链、反射/透射、CFL 安全比与 dt_max、介质 Z=ρc 与 Z=√(Kρ)、相速 ω/k、每波长点数、渡越时间、声能量密度、I–u 闭合残差、iuda-dense multi-CFL / thirtieth-grid ranking honesty、juda-dense multi-CFL / thirty-first-grid ranking honesty）。对应 principle-bridge 声学平面波合同；数值 residual tip 桥接 @w-sim/solvers-acoustics S28cj iuda-dense residual + S28ck juda-dense residual（landed；下接 S28cl）——**smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation**。
children.bodyEn: Composing medium (c,Z,k,T) + wave march + iuda-dense multi-CFL residual + juda-dense multi-CFL residual should reproduce plane-wave p/v=Z, v=p/Z, intensity, I=u·c energy-flux link, reflection/transmission, CFL/dt_max, Z=ρc and Z=√(Kρ), phase speed ω/k, PPW, travel time, energy density, I–u closure residual, iuda-dense multi-CFL / thirtieth-grid ranking honesty, and juda-dense multi-CFL / thirty-first-grid ranking honesty KPIs; bridges @w-sim/solvers-acoustics S28cj iuda-dense residual + S28ck juda-dense residual (landed; next S28cl) — smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation.

children.titleZh: 合成：平面波 p/v = Z
children.bodyZh: 把特征阻抗 Z=ρc 与场幅合成：均匀介质正向行波 |p|/|v_n|≈Z。工程 smoke 常校验空气/水行波的 p/v 比与 Z 一致。
children.bodyEn: Composes medium Z with fields: progressive plane wave |p|/|v_n|≈Z; smoke checks p/v vs Z.

vars.ratio: 声压/法向质点速度比 Pa·s/m

formula.plainZh: 平面波声压与质点速度幅度比等于特征阻抗
formula.plainEn: Plane-wave pressure-to-particle-velocity amplitude ratio equals characteristic impedance

children.titleZh: 合成：时均声强 I = p² / (2 Z)
children.titleEn: Compose: time-average intensity I = p² / (2 Z)
children.bodyZh: 把声压幅与阻抗合成能量流：平面波时均强度 I = p_rms²/Z = p²/(2Z)（p 为峰值）。连接 principle「阻抗」与可观测功率流 KPI。
children.bodyEn: Composes pressure amplitude with Z into intensity I=p²/(2Z) for progressive plane waves.

formula.plainZh: 平面波时均声强等于声压峰值平方除以二倍特征阻抗
formula.plainEn: Plane-wave time-average intensity is peak pressure squared over twice the impedance

children.titleZh: 合成：正入射反射 R = (Z₂−Z₁)/(Z₂+Z₁)
children.bodyZh: 把两侧特征阻抗与边界语义合成：压力释放面 Z₂→0 ⇒ R→−1（声压反相）；硬壁 Z₂→∞ ⇒ R→+1；匹配 Z₂=Z₁ ⇒ R=0。连接 principle「介质 Z」与界面/边界。
children.bodyEn: Composes two-sided Z with BC: pressure-release Z₂→0 ⇒ R→−1; rigid Z₂→∞ ⇒ R→+1; matched ⇒ R=0.

formula.plainZh: 正入射声压反射系数由两侧特征阻抗决定，压力释放面极限为 −1
formula.plainEn: Normal-incidence pressure reflection from two impedances; pressure-release limit is −1

children.titleZh: 合成：Z = √(K ρ)（由 c 与 Z 定义拼回）
children.titleEn: Compose: Z = √(K ρ) from c and Z definitions
children.bodyZh: 把 foundation「c=√(K/ρ)」与「Z=ρc」合成：Z=√(Kρ)。水算例 K=2.2 GPa、ρ=1000 → Z≈1.483×10⁶ Pa·s/m，构成介质参数两侧的可观测量合同。
children.bodyEn: Composes c=√(K/ρ) with Z=ρc into Z=√(Kρ); water sample K=2.2e9, ρ=1000.

formula.plainZh: 特征阻抗等于体积模量与密度乘积的开方
formula.plainEn: Characteristic impedance is the square root of bulk modulus times density

children.titleZh: 合成：匹配校核 Z 与 p/v
children.titleEn: Compose: match check Z vs p/v
children.bodyZh: 介质公式 Z 与场比 p/v 应一致：残差 |p/v − Z|/|Z|。算例 p/v=Z 时残差为 0，构成介质参数与场观测的合成合同。
children.bodyEn: Medium Z and field ratio p/v must agree; residual |p/v−Z|/|Z|; sample matched → 0.

formula.plainZh: 平面波场比与特征阻抗的相对残差在匹配时应为零
formula.plainEn: Relative residual between field ratio and characteristic impedance is zero when matched

children.titleZh: 合成：波长 λ = 2π c / ω
children.bodyZh: 把声速与角频率（或 k=ω/c）合成波长：λ=2π/k=2π c/ω。网格每波长点数 N_λ=λ/dx 是分辨率 KPI 的常见合成量。
children.bodyEn: Composes c and ω into λ=2π c/ω; points-per-wavelength N_λ=λ/dx is a resolution KPI.

formula.plainZh: 波长等于声速除以频率，也等于二π乘声速再除以角频率
formula.plainEn: Wavelength is sound speed over frequency, or 2π c over angular frequency

children.titleZh: 合成：正入射压力透射 T = 2 Z₂ / (Z₁ + Z₂)
children.titleEn: Compose: normal-incidence pressure T = 2 Z₂ / (Z₁ + Z₂)
children.bodyZh: 把两侧特征阻抗合成压力透射系数：T_p = 2 Z₂/(Z₁+Z₂)。匹配 Z₂=Z₁ ⇒ T=1；压力释放 Z₂→0 ⇒ T→0；硬壁 Z₂→∞ ⇒ T→2（界面压力加倍语义）。与 R=(Z₂−Z₁)/(Z₂+Z₁) 合应满足 1+R=T。
children.bodyEn: Composes two-sided Z into pressure transmission T_p=2Z₂/(Z₁+Z₂); matched T=1; pressure-release T→0; rigid T→2; with R satisfies 1+R=T.

formula.plainZh: 正入射声压透射系数由两侧特征阻抗合成，匹配时等于 1
formula.plainEn: Normal-incidence pressure transmission from two impedances equals 1 when matched

children.titleZh: 合成：渡越时间 τ = L / c
children.titleEn: Compose: travel time τ = L / c
children.bodyZh: 把传播路径长度 L 与声速合成渡越时间：τ=L/c。平面波相位延迟 KPI 与时域 TOF 标定常用此合成；算例 L=340 m、c=340 m/s → τ=1 s。
children.bodyEn: Composes path length and sound speed into travel time τ=L/c; used for phase delay and TOF KPIs; sample L=c=340 → 1 s.

formula.plainZh: 声波渡越时间等于路径长度除以声速
formula.plainEn: Acoustic travel time is path length over sound speed

children.titleZh: 合成：时均声能量密度 u = p² / (2 ρ c²)
children.titleEn: Compose: time-average energy density u = p² / (2 ρ c²)
children.bodyZh: 把声压峰值与介质 (ρ,c) 合成平面波时均能量密度：u = p_rms²/(ρ c²) = p²/(2 ρ c²)。与强度 I=p²/(2Z) 合应满足 I = u · c（因 Z=ρc）。算例空气 p=Z=408、ρ=1.2、c=340 → u=0.6 J/m³。
children.bodyEn: Composes peak pressure with (ρ,c) into energy density u=p²/(2ρc²); with I=p²/(2Z) yields I=u·c; air sample u=0.6.

formula.expr: u = p * p / (2 * rho * c * c)
formula.plainZh: 平面波时均声能量密度等于声压峰值平方除以二倍密度与声速平方
formula.plainEn: Plane-wave time-average energy density is peak pressure squared over twice density times sound-speed squared

children.titleZh: 合成：c = √(K/ρ) 入波推进链
children.bodyZh: 材料 (K,ρ) 先合成声速 c，再进入波长、CFL、渡越与阻抗链。水算例 K=2.2 GPa、ρ=1000 → c≈1483 m/s，与 foundation-c 及 Z=√(Kρ) 合同。
children.bodyEn: Composes bulk modulus and density into sound speed upstream of λ, CFL, TOF, and Z; water sample c≈1483 m/s.

formula.plainZh: 声速由体积模量与密度合成，作为波动推进与阻抗的上游
formula.plainEn: Sound speed composes from bulk modulus and density as upstream of wave march and impedance

children.titleZh: 合成：质点速度 v = p / Z
children.titleEn: Compose: particle velocity v = p / Z
children.bodyZh: 平面波场反演：由声压峰值与特征阻抗合成法向质点速度 v=p/Z，与 p/v=Z 对偶。算例 p=Z=408 → v=1 m/s，进入强度与能量密度链。
children.bodyEn: Dual of p/v=Z: recover normal particle velocity v=p/Z; sample p=Z=408 → v=1 m/s.

formula.plainZh: 平面波质点速度由声压峰值除以特征阻抗反演合成
formula.plainEn: Plane-wave particle velocity recovers from peak pressure over characteristic impedance

children.titleZh: 合成：Z = ρ c 入阻抗链
children.titleEn: Compose: Z = ρ c into impedance chain
children.bodyZh: 材料 (ρ,c) 合成特征阻抗后进入 p/v、反射/透射与强度链。空气算例 ρ=1.2、c=340 → Z=408，与 foundation-impedance 及平面波合同对齐。
children.bodyEn: Composes density and sound speed into Z upstream of p/v, R/T, and intensity; air sample Z=408.

formula.plainZh: 特征阻抗由密度与声速合成，作为平面波场比与界面系数上游
formula.plainEn: Characteristic impedance composes from density and sound speed upstream of field ratios and interface coeffs

children.titleZh: 合成：声强 I = u · c（能流链）
children.titleEn: Compose: intensity I = u · c (energy-flux link)
children.bodyZh: 平面波时均声强与能量密度应满足 I = u · c（因 Z=ρc 时 p²/(2Z) = [p²/(2ρc²)]·c）。连接 energy-density 与 intensity 两套合成。算例 u=0.6、c=340 → I=204。
children.bodyEn: Plane-wave mean intensity and energy density link as I=u·c when Z=ρc; sample u=0.6, c=340 → I=204.

formula.plainZh: 平面波时均声强等于声能量密度乘声速
formula.plainEn: Plane-wave time-average intensity equals energy density times sound speed

children.titleZh: 合成：相速 c_p = ω / k
children.titleEn: Compose: phase speed c_p = ω / k
children.bodyZh: 把角频率与波数合成相速：无色散介质 c_p=ω/k 应等于材料声速 c。算例 ω=2π·1000、k=ω/340 → c_p=340，闭合 foundation-k 与介质 c。
children.bodyEn: Composes ω and k into phase speed; non-dispersive c_p=ω/k equals material c; sample 340 m/s.

formula.plainZh: 无色散介质相速由角频率除以波数合成，应等于材料声速
formula.plainEn: Non-dispersive phase speed composes as angular frequency over wavenumber and equals material sound speed

children.titleZh: 合成：CFL 上界 dt_max = dx / c 入安全比
children.titleEn: Compose: CFL bound dt_max = dx / c into safety ratio
children.bodyZh: 网格与声速先合成 dt_max=dx/c，再与实际 dt 合成安全比 s=dt/dt_max。算例 dx=1 mm、c=340 → dt_max≈2.94 μs，与 foundation-dt-max 及 cfl-ratio 同链。
children.bodyEn: Composes dx and c into dt_max upstream of s=dt/dt_max; sample dx=1e-3, c=340.

formula.plainZh: 一维声学稳定时间步上界由网格间距除以声速合成
formula.plainEn: One-dimensional acoustic max stable time step composes as mesh spacing over sound speed

children.titleZh: 合成：频率 f = c / λ
children.bodyZh: 把声速与波长合成频率：f=c/λ，与 λ=c/f、N_λ=λ/dx 同链。算例 c=340、λ=0.34 → f=1000 Hz，对接 wavelength 与 ppw KPI。
children.bodyEn: Composes c and λ into f=c/λ; sample 340/0.34 → 1 kHz; links wavelength and PPW.

formula.plainZh: 声波频率由声速除以波长合成
formula.plainEn: Acoustic frequency composes as sound speed over wavelength

children.titleZh: L0：Sound / Ultrasound 教学叶子
children.bodyZh: WaveWorld 页 Sound、Ultrasound、Ripple 等可承载教学演示；不计入 engineering DoD。
children.bodyEn: Teaching pages may demo waves; not engineering DoD credit.

titleZh: 分子动力学 LJ（工程 kind）
summaryZh: W-Sim BuiltinJobKind md-batch：牛顿 MD + Lennard-Jones 对势；工程路径归 @w-sim/solvers-md。
summaryEn: W-Sim kind md-batch: Newtonian MD + LJ pairs; owned by @w-sim/solvers-md.

explainRoot.bodyZh: 顶层工程计算方法：粒子在对势力下按牛顿第二定律积分，输出能量、力与轨迹 KPI。数值实现归 @w-sim/solvers-md（Verlet / Langevin / PBC 等模式）。
explainRoot.bodyEn: Particles integrate Newton under pair forces; owned by @w-sim/solvers-md.

children.titleZh: 原理：Lennard-Jones 对势
children.bodyZh: 短程排斥 ~ r⁻¹² 与长程吸引 ~ r⁻⁶ 合成经典对势；总势能是粒子对之和（可加 cutoff / 软化）。
children.bodyEn: Repulsive r⁻¹² + attractive r⁻⁶; total U is sum of pairs (optional cutoff/softening).

children.titleZh: 基础式：U(r) = 4ε [(σ/r)¹² − (σ/r)⁶]
children.bodyZh: ε 为阱深，σ 为零势距。在 r_min = 2^(1/6) σ 处 U = −ε。要求 r>0、ε>0、σ>0。
children.bodyEn: Well depth ε, zero-crossing σ; U(−ε) at r_min = 2^(1/6) σ.

formula.plainZh: LJ 对势能由 12–6 幂次与阱深、特征长度决定
formula.plainEn: LJ pair energy from 12–6 powers with well depth and length scale

children.titleZh: 基础：中心力 F = −dU/dr
children.bodyZh: 径向力幅度 F(r) = (24ε/r) [2(σ/r)¹² − (σ/r)⁶]；正号为排斥。n-body 按 Newton III 成对累加。
children.bodyEn: Radial magnitude F=(24ε/r)[2(σ/r)¹²−(σ/r)⁶]; pairs obey Newton III.

formula.plainZh: 在 r=σ 处 LJ 径向力幅度为 24ε/σ
formula.plainEn: At r=σ the LJ radial force magnitude is 24ε/σ

children.titleZh: 基础式：r_min = 2^{1/6} σ
children.bodyZh: 对势极小点：dU/dr = 0 时 r_min = 2^{1/6} σ ≈ 1.122 σ。此处吸引与排斥径向力相消，U(r_min) = −ε。
children.bodyEn: Potential minimum at r_min = 2^{1/6} σ; force cancels and U = −ε.

formula.plainZh: LJ 势阱最小间距等于 2 的六分之一次方乘特征长度 σ
formula.plainEn: LJ well minimum distance is 2^(1/6) times σ

children.titleZh: 基础式：U(r_min) = −ε
children.bodyZh: 阱深定义：在 r_min 处对势能恰好等于 −ε。工程/教学 smoke 常以 ε=1、σ=1 的约化单位自检。
children.bodyEn: Well depth: U(r_min)=−ε; reduced units often take ε=σ=1.

formula.plainZh: LJ 阱底对势能等于负的阱深 −ε
formula.plainEn: LJ well-bottom pair energy equals minus the well depth −ε

children.titleZh: 基础式：U = 4ε (s⁶)² − 4ε s⁶，s = σ/r
children.bodyZh: 实现友好写法：先算 sr6 = (σ/r)⁶，则 U = 4ε (sr6² − sr6)。在 r=σ 时 sr6=1、U=0（零势距）。
children.bodyEn: Implement as sr6=(σ/r)⁶ then U=4ε(sr6²−sr6); at r=σ, U=0.

formula.plainZh: 用 (σ/r)⁶ 中间量计算 LJ 对势能，在 r=σ 处为零
formula.plainEn: LJ pair energy via (σ/r)⁶ intermediate; zero at r=σ

children.titleZh: 基础：r_min 处 F = 0
children.bodyZh: 在 r = 2^{1/6} σ 处 (σ/r)⁶ = 1/2，故 2(σ/r)¹² − (σ/r)⁶ = 0，径向力幅度为零（力学平衡点）。
children.bodyEn: At r_min, (σ/r)⁶=1/2 so radial force magnitude vanishes (mechanical equilibrium).

formula.plainZh: 在 LJ 势阱最小间距处径向力幅度为零
formula.plainEn: Radial LJ force magnitude is zero at the potential minimum

children.titleZh: 基础式：U_tot = Σ_{i<j} U(r_ij)
children.bodyZh: 经典对势总势能是无序对之和（等价 ½ Σ_i Σ_{j≠i}）。三粒子全连接时 U_tot = U12+U13+U23；算例取三对均在阱底 → U_tot = −3ε。
children.bodyEn: Total pair energy is unordered pair sum; three particles at well bottoms → U_tot=−3ε.

formula.plainZh: 系统 LJ 对势总能等于各无序粒子对势能之和
formula.plainEn: Total LJ pair energy is the sum over unordered particle pairs

children.titleZh: 假设与有效域
children.bodyZh: 成对可加、经典点粒子、可选截断/移位/长程尾修正；化学键/多体势/量子核需扩展。r→0 时 r⁻¹² 发散，实现需软化或邻域列表 + 最小镜像。工程 smoke 覆盖能量残差与 Newton III 力闭合。
children.bodyEn: Pairwise classical points; bonds/many-body/quantum need extensions; eng smoke covers energy residual and force closure.

children.titleZh: 原理：牛顿第二定律与积分
children.bodyZh: m a = F；Verlet / velocity-Verlet 守恒性好；Langevin / BAOAB 引入热浴。温控/压控是控制层，叠在 LJ+Newton 之上。
children.bodyEn: m a = F; Verlet conserves well; Langevin/BAOAB add thermostats.

children.titleZh: 基础式：Verlet 位置步 x′ = x + v Δt + ½ a Δt²
children.titleEn: Foundation: Verlet position step x′ = x + v Δt + ½ a Δt²
children.bodyZh: velocity-Verlet / 等价形式的位置更新。dt 需分辨最快振动；过大 dt 使能量漂移爆炸。工程 smoke 覆盖多步能量残差与力闭合。
children.bodyEn: Position half of velocity-Verlet; dt must resolve fastest modes; smoke covers energy residual.

formula.expr: x_new = x + v * dt + 0.5 * a * dt * dt
formula.plainZh: Verlet 位置步由当前坐标、速度与加速度二次展开得到
formula.plainEn: Verlet position update from current x, v, and acceleration

children.titleZh: 基础式：KE = ½ m v²
children.bodyZh: 单粒子平动动能。多体时 KE = Σ_i ½ m_i |v_i|²。与对势 U_tot 合成为守恒可观测量 E。
children.bodyEn: Per-particle kinetic energy; many-body sums ½ m |v|²; with U_tot forms conserved E.

formula.plainZh: 平动动能等于二分之一质量乘速率平方
formula.plainEn: Translational kinetic energy is one-half mass times speed squared

children.titleZh: 基础式：E = KE + U_tot
children.bodyZh: 微正则（NVE）下总能量近似守恒：动能 + LJ 对势总能。工程 KPI 常报 |E(t)−E(0)|/|E(0)| 能量残差。
children.bodyEn: NVE total energy ≈ KE + pair U; eng KPI often relative energy residual.

formula.plainZh: 总机械能等于动能与 LJ 对势总能之和
formula.plainEn: Total mechanical energy is kinetic plus LJ pair potential

children.titleZh: 基础：Newton III 力闭合 F_ij + F_ji = 0
children.bodyZh: 中心力对势自动满足作用反作用；成对累加时总动量源项为零。smoke 校验 Σ F ≈ 0（除外力/热浴）。
children.bodyEn: Central pair forces obey action–reaction; smoke checks ΣF≈0 absent external/thermostat forces.

formula.plainZh: LJ 中心力对满足作用力与反作用力之和为零
formula.plainEn: LJ central pair forces sum to zero by Newton III

children.titleZh: 工程包：solvers-md
children.bodyZh: JobKind `md-batch` 由 @w-sim/solvers-md 拥有；经 kind-matrix 与 lab-kit 登记（lj-pair / PBC / cell-list / thermostat / triclinic honesty duals S29ac–S29ba + mad↔min/clad S29ca + max↔min/Cosine/Bray–Curtis plated S29cb 等 fixture）。**smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation**。
children.bodyEn: Owned by @w-sim/solvers-md; kind-matrix + lab-kit fixtures including triclinic honesty duals S29ac–S29ba; smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation.

children.titleZh: 合成视角：LJ 对势 ∘ 牛顿积分 ∘ NVT/NPT 控制 ≈ MD 方法
children.titleEn: Compose: LJ pair ∘ Newton march ∘ NVT/NPT control ≈ MD method
children.bodyZh: 科技树语义：更基础的「Lennard-Jones 对势/对力/对势求和/阱底/sr6 实现/零势距」与「牛顿/Verlet 积分 + 动能 + a=F/m + 速度半步」及「NVT/NPT 温压控与平衡诚实」合成应在等价域复现顶层 MD KPI（NVE 能量残差 E=KE+U、Newton III 力平衡、Verlet 步进、温度与 KE–T 残差、r_min/U_min、对势求和、平衡点力残差、力尺度匹配、无序对数、速度缩放/Berendsen λ、T/P 残差、维里压力、体积耦合、Langevin 阻尼、三斜 h 盒 det/半间距/绝对邻格、维里对称、静水压、列表比、skin 重建门、μ 体积缩放、early/trailing dual T/P/V/剪切窗诚实残差）。对应 principle-bridge `eq-md-lj-newton` 与系综控制层；数值 residual tip 桥接 @w-sim/solvers-md triclinic honesty duals（S29ac–S29ba + S29ca mad↔min/Minkowski-4/Canberra/clad floors + S29cb max↔min/Cosine/Bray–Curtis plated honesty landed 等）——**smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation**。
children.bodyEn: Composing LJ pair energy/force/well/sr6/zero-cross with Newton/Verlet+KE+a=F/m+velocity half-step and NVT/NPT control should reproduce energy residual, force-closure, Verlet, temperature/KE–T residual, r_min/U_min, pair-sum, equilibrium-force residual, force-scale match, pair-count, velocity/Berendsen scale, T/P residuals, virial pressure, volume coupling, Langevin drag, and triclinic h-box det/half-spacing/abs lattice/virial symmetry/hydrostatic/list-ratio/skin gate/μ volume/dual T·P·V·shear window honesty KPIs; see eq-md-lj-newton plus ensemble control; bridges @w-sim/solvers-md triclinic honesty duals (S29ac–S29ba + S29ca mad↔min/Minkowski-4/Canberra/clad floors + S29cb max↔min/Cosine/Bray–Curtis plated honesty landed) — smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation.

children.titleZh: 合成：E = KE + Σ_pairs U
children.bodyZh: 把对势求和与动能拼回总能量：E = KE + U_tot。此式连接 principle「LJ 对势」与「Newton/积分」两侧，构成 MD 方法的可观测量合同。
children.bodyEn: Reassembles pair-sum U with KE into conserved E; contracts LJ principle with Newton march.

formula.plainZh: MD 合成总能量等于动能加对势求和
formula.plainEn: Composed MD total energy is kinetic plus pair-potential sum

children.titleZh: 合成：Verlet 位置步进 x′ = 2x − x_prev + a dt²
children.titleEn: Compose: Verlet step x′ = 2x − x_prev + a dt²
children.bodyZh: 把加速度（来自 LJ 力/质量）与两步位置合成下一位置。无速度显式存储的经典中心差分。
children.bodyEn: Composes acceleration from LJ force/mass with two positions into next x; classic central-difference Verlet.

formula.expr: x_new = 2 * x - x_prev + a * dt * dt
formula.plainZh: Verlet 合成下一步位置由当前/上步位置与加速度时间步给出
formula.plainEn: Verlet composes next position from current/previous positions and a·dt²

children.titleZh: 合成：动能温度 T ∝ KE / N_dof
children.titleEn: Compose: kinetic temperature T ∝ KE / N_dof
children.bodyZh: 把总动能与自由度合成瞬时温度量级：KE = (N_dof/2) k_B T（约化单位常取 k_B=1）。算例 KE=9、N_dof=6 → T=3。
children.bodyEn: Composes KE and degrees of freedom into instantaneous T; reduced units k_B=1; sample T=3.

formula.plainZh: 动能温度由总动能与自由度数目合成
formula.plainEn: Kinetic temperature is composed from total kinetic energy and degrees of freedom

children.titleZh: 合成：对力尺度 F ~ 24 ε/σ（r=σ）
children.titleEn: Compose: pair force scale F ~ 24 ε/σ at r=σ
children.bodyZh: 在 r=σ 处 LJ 径向力幅量级 24ε/σ，用于校验力实现与势参数一致。
children.bodyEn: At r=σ LJ radial force magnitude is 24ε/σ; smoke-checks force vs potential params.

formula.plainZh: r=σ 处 LJ 对力尺度等于 24ε/σ
formula.plainEn: LJ pair force scale at r=σ is 24ε/σ

children.titleZh: 合成：KE = ½ m v² 入能量链
children.titleEn: Compose: KE = ½ m v² into energy chain
children.bodyZh: 把质量与速率合成平动动能，再与对势 U 拼回守恒 E。算例 m=2、v=3 → KE=9，与 foundation-ke / etot 合同。
children.bodyEn: Composes mass and speed into KE upstream of conserved E; sample m=2,v=3 → KE=9.

formula.plainZh: 动能由质量与速率合成，作为总能量链的动能侧输入
formula.plainEn: Kinetic energy composes from mass and speed as the KE side of the total-energy chain

children.titleZh: 合成：a = F / m（Newton II）
children.bodyZh: 把 LJ 对力与粒子质量合成加速度，供 Verlet / velocity-Verlet 位置更新。算例 F=24（r=σ 力尺度）、m=2 → a=12。
children.bodyEn: Composes LJ force and mass into acceleration for Verlet; sample F=24, m=2 → a=12.

formula.plainZh: 加速度等于净力除以质量，连接 LJ 力与 Verlet 积分
formula.plainEn: Acceleration is net force over mass, linking LJ force to Verlet integration

children.titleZh: 合成：r_min = 2^{1/6} σ 入力零点链
children.titleEn: Compose: r_min = 2^{1/6} σ into force-zero chain
children.bodyZh: 材料长度尺度 σ 先合成势阱最小间距 r_min，再进入 F(r_min)=0 与 U=−ε 合同。约化 σ=1 → r_min=2^{1/6}。
children.bodyEn: Composes σ into well minimum r_min upstream of F=0 and U=−ε; reduced σ=1 → 2^{1/6}.

formula.plainZh: 势阱最小间距由特征长度 σ 合成，作为力零点与阱深合同的上游
formula.plainEn: Well minimum distance composes from σ as upstream of force-zero and well-depth contracts

children.titleZh: 合成：U_min = −ε 阱深合同
children.bodyZh: 把阱深参数 ε 合成阱底对势能；与 r_min 处 U(r) 金标对拍。算例 ε=1 → U_min=−1。
children.bodyEn: Composes well-depth ε into bottom pair energy; gold-checks U(r_min); sample −1.

formula.plainZh: 阱底对势能由阱深 ε 合成，等于 −ε
formula.plainEn: Well-bottom pair energy composes from well depth as −ε

children.titleZh: 合成：U_tot = Σ_pairs U 入总能
children.titleEn: Compose: U_tot = Σ_pairs U into total energy
children.bodyZh: 无序粒子对势能求和作为 U 侧输入，再与 KE 合成 E。三粒子全连接阱底算例 U12=U13=U23=−ε → U_tot=−3。
children.bodyEn: Unordered pair-sum U feeds total E with KE; three well-bottom pairs → U_tot=−3ε.

formula.plainZh: 系统对势总能由各粒子对势能合成，再进入动能–势能守恒链
formula.plainEn: Total pair energy composes from pair terms before the KE–PE conservation chain

children.titleZh: 合成：E = KE + U_tot 守恒合同
children.titleEn: Compose: E = KE + U_tot conservation contract
children.bodyZh: 把动能侧与对势侧合成总机械能；NVE smoke 以 |E−E0|/|E0| 报残差。算例 KE=9、U_tot=−1 → E=8。
children.bodyEn: Composes KE and pair U into total E; NVE smoke reports relative drift; sample E=8.

formula.plainZh: 总机械能由动能与对势总能合成，构成 NVE 守恒合同
formula.plainEn: Total mechanical energy composes from KE and pair U as the NVE conservation contract

children.titleZh: 合成：U = 4ε (sr6² − sr6) 实现链
children.bodyZh: 把中间量 sr6=(σ/r)⁶ 与阱深合成对势能：U=4ε(sr6²−sr6)。算例 sr6=1（r=σ）→ U=0，对接零势距与 foundation-sr6。
children.bodyEn: Composes intermediate sr6=(σ/r)⁶ with ε into U=4ε(sr6²−sr6); sample sr6=1 → U=0 at zero-crossing.

formula.plainZh: LJ 对势能由 (σ/r)⁶ 中间量与阱深合成，便于实现与零势距自检
formula.plainEn: LJ pair energy composes from the (σ/r)⁶ intermediate and well depth for implementation and zero-crossing checks

children.titleZh: 合成：速度半步 v′ = v + a Δt
children.titleEn: Compose: velocity half-step v′ = v + a Δt
children.bodyZh: 把加速度（来自 a=F/m）与时间步合成 velocity-Verlet 速度更新半步。算例 v=1、a=−2、dt=0.1 → v′=0.8，对接位置 Verlet 与动能链。
children.bodyEn: Composes acceleration and dt into velocity-Verlet half-step; sample v=1,a=−2,dt=0.1 → 0.8; links position Verlet and KE.

formula.plainZh: 速度半步由当前速度加加速度乘时间步合成，对接 Verlet 与动能
formula.plainEn: Velocity half-step composes as current velocity plus acceleration times dt, linking Verlet and kinetic energy

children.titleZh: 合成：无序对数 N_pairs = N(N−1)/2
children.titleEn: Compose: unordered pair count N_pairs = N(N−1)/2
children.bodyZh: 把粒子数合成无序对势求和项数，作为 U_tot=Σ U_ij 的组合上游。算例 N=3 → N_pairs=3（与三粒子 U12+U13+U23 对齐）。
children.bodyEn: Composes particle count into unordered pair count upstream of U_tot; sample N=3 → 3 pairs.

formula.plainZh: 无序粒子对数由粒子数按组合数 N(N−1)/2 合成，作为对势求和上游
formula.plainEn: Unordered pair count composes as N(N−1)/2 upstream of the pair-potential sum

children.titleZh: 合成：N_dof = 3N − 3 入温度链
children.bodyZh: 粒子数先合成去质心自由度，再进入 T=2 KE/N_dof 与 NVT 残差。算例 N=100 → N_dof=297。
children.bodyEn: Composes N into COM-removed dof upstream of T and NVT residual; sample N=100 → 297.

formula.plainZh: 自由度由粒子数按 3N−3 合成，作为动能温度与 NVT 诚实合同上游
formula.plainEn: Degrees of freedom compose as 3N−3 from particle count upstream of kinetic T and NVT honesty

children.titleZh: 合成：T = 2 KE / N_dof 入热浴
children.titleEn: Compose: T = 2 KE / N_dof into thermostat
children.bodyZh: 把总动能与自由度合成瞬时温度，供速度缩放 / Berendsen / Langevin 比较 T★。算例 KE=150、N_dof=297 → T≈1.0101。
children.bodyEn: Composes KE and N_dof into instantaneous T for thermostat vs T★; sample ≈1.0101.

formula.plainZh: 瞬时温度由动能与自由度合成，进入 NVT 温控链
formula.plainEn: Instantaneous temperature composes from KE and dof into the NVT thermostat chain

children.titleZh: 合成：λ = √(T★ / T) 速度缩放
children.bodyZh: 把目标温度与瞬时温度合成理想速度缩放因子，使一步重标后 T→T★。算例 T★=1、T=0.81 → λ=√(1/0.81)。
children.bodyEn: Composes T★ and T into ideal velocity scale; sample √(1/0.81).

formula.plainZh: 速度缩放因子由目标温度与瞬时温度比的平方根合成
formula.plainEn: Velocity scale factor composes as the square root of target over instantaneous temperature

children.titleZh: 合成：v′ = λ v 施加速度缩放
children.titleEn: Compose: v′ = λ v apply velocity scale
children.bodyZh: 把缩放因子与当前速度合成热浴更新速度。算例 λ=√(1/0.81)、v=1 → v′=√(1/0.81)。
children.bodyEn: Applies scale factor to velocity; sample λ=√(1/0.81), v=1.

formula.plainZh: 热浴速度更新等于缩放因子乘当前速度
formula.plainEn: Thermostatted velocity update is the scale factor times current velocity

children.titleZh: 合成：KE′ = λ² KE 缩放后动能
children.titleEn: Compose: KE′ = λ² KE after scale
children.bodyZh: 速度统一乘 λ 后动能乘 λ²，连接温度重标与 KE–T 合同。算例 λ²=1/0.81、KE=0.81 → KE′=1。
children.bodyEn: Uniform velocity scale multiplies KE by λ²; sample λ²·0.81 → 1.

formula.plainZh: 速度缩放后动能等于 λ 平方乘原动能，对接温度重标
formula.plainEn: Post-scale kinetic energy is λ squared times prior KE, linking temperature rescaling

children.titleZh: 合成：Berendsen λ 弱耦合温控
children.bodyZh: 把 Δt、τ_T 与 T★/T 合成软缩放因子，避免一步过冲。算例 Δt=0.001、τ_T=0.1、T★=1、T=0.81。
children.bodyEn: Composes dt, τ_T, and T★/T into soft scale; sample as foundation Berendsen.

formula.plainZh: Berendsen 缩放因子由时间步、耦合时间与温度偏差合成
formula.plainEn: Berendsen scale composes from time step, coupling time, and temperature error

children.titleZh: 合成：平衡窗 T̄ = (T1+T2+T3)/3
children.bodyZh: 把若干瞬时温度样本合成窗平均，再进入 T 残差 KPI。算例 0.99、1.01、1.03 → T̄=1.01。
children.bodyEn: Composes instantaneous T samples into window mean upstream of residual; sample 1.01.

formula.plainZh: 平衡窗平均温度由若干瞬时温度样本算术平均合成
formula.plainEn: Equilibration window-mean temperature composes as the arithmetic mean of instantaneous samples

children.titleZh: 合成：Langevin 阻尼 F_L = −γ m v
children.titleEn: Compose: Langevin drag F_L = −γ m v
children.bodyZh: 把摩擦系数、质量与速度合成阻尼力，与 LJ 力叠加后再 a=F/m。算例 γ=1、m=1、v=2 → F_L=−2。
children.bodyEn: Composes γ, m, v into drag force added to LJ before a=F/m; sample −2.

formula.plainZh: Langevin 阻尼力由摩擦系数、质量与速度合成，叠加到 LJ 力
formula.plainEn: Langevin drag composes from friction, mass, and velocity and stacks on LJ force

children.titleZh: 合成：P_kin = N T / V 入压控
children.titleEn: Compose: P_kin = N T / V into barostat
children.bodyZh: 约化理想气体动能压力由 N、T、V 合成，作为 NPT 压力观测的动能侧。算例 N=100、T=1、V=1000 → 0.1。
children.bodyEn: Composes N, T, V into kinetic pressure for NPT; sample 0.1.

formula.plainZh: 动能压力由粒子数、温度与体积合成，进入 NPT 压力观测
formula.plainEn: Kinetic pressure composes from N, T, and V into the NPT pressure observable

children.titleZh: 合成：P = (2 KE + W) / (3 V) 维里压力
children.titleEn: Compose: P = (2 KE + W) / (3 V) virial pressure
children.bodyZh: 把动能与对力维里、体积合成瞬时压力，供 P 残差与 barostat。算例 KE=150、W=0、V=1000 → P=0.1。
children.bodyEn: Composes KE, pair virial, and V into instantaneous P; sample 0.1.

formula.plainZh: 维里压力由动能、对力维里与体积合成，作为 NPT 诚实观测
formula.plainEn: Virial pressure composes from KE, pair virial, and volume as the NPT honesty observable

children.titleZh: 合成：Berendsen 体积步 V′ 入 NPT
children.titleEn: Compose: Berendsen volume step V′ into NPT
children.bodyZh: 把体积、压缩率、耦合时间与压力偏差合成下一步体积。算例 V=1000、κ=1、Δt/τ_P=0.01、P★−P=0.1 → V′=999。
children.bodyEn: Composes V, κ, τ_P, and pressure error into next volume; sample V′=999.

formula.plainZh: NPT 体积更新由压缩率、耦合时间与压力偏差合成
formula.plainEn: NPT volume update composes compressibility, coupling time, and pressure error

children.titleZh: 合成：数密度 ρ = N / V
children.titleEn: Compose: number density ρ = N / V
children.bodyZh: 把粒子数与体积合成数密度，对接 P_kin=ρ T 与 NPT 密度报告。算例 N=100、V=1000 → ρ=0.1。
children.bodyEn: Composes N and V into number density; sample 0.1; links P_kin=ρ T.

formula.plainZh: 数密度由粒子数除以体积合成，对接动能压力与 NPT 密度
formula.plainEn: Number density composes as N over V upstream of kinetic pressure and NPT density reports

children.titleZh: 合成：立方盒边 L = V^{1/3}
children.titleEn: Compose: cubic box edge L = V^{1/3}
children.bodyZh: 各向同性 barostat 后体积合成边长，供 PBC 与最小镜像。算例 V=1000 → L=10。
children.bodyEn: Composes volume into cubic edge after isotropic barostat; sample L=10.

formula.plainZh: 立方周期盒边长由体积的立方根合成
formula.plainEn: Cubic periodic box edge composes as the cube root of volume

children.titleZh: 合成：P_kin = ρ T 理想气体链闭合
children.titleEn: Compose: P_kin = ρ T ideal-gas chain closure
children.bodyZh: 数密度与温度合成动能压力，应与 N T / V 一致。算例 ρ=0.1、T=1 → P_kin=0.1。
children.bodyEn: Composes density and T into kinetic pressure matching N T/V; sample 0.1.

formula.plainZh: 动能压力亦可由数密度乘温度合成，与 N T/V 链闭合
formula.plainEn: Kinetic pressure also composes as density times temperature, closing the N T/V chain

children.titleZh: 合成：三斜盒体积 V = det(h)（正交）
children.titleEn: Compose: triclinic box volume V = det(h) (orthogonal)
children.bodyZh: h 列向量为晶格基矢；正交对角 h=diag(Lx,Ly,Lz) 时 det(h)=Lx Ly Lz。算例立方 L=10 → V=1000，与 md-compose-L-box 对偶，桥接 S29ac triclinic 体积合同。
children.bodyEn: h columns are lattice vectors; orthogonal det=Lx Ly Lz; sample cubic L=10 → V=1000; dual of L-box; bridges S29ac volume contract.

formula.plainZh: 正交三斜盒体积由三边长乘积合成，等于 det(h)
formula.plainEn: Orthogonal triclinic box volume composes as the product of edge lengths, equal to det(h)

children.titleZh: 合成：立方半最小面间距 L/2
children.titleEn: Compose: cubic min half interplanar spacing L/2
children.bodyZh: 分数最小镜像安全截断上界：r_cut、r_list ≤ 半最小面间距。立方 h=diag(L,L,L) 时半间距=L/2。算例 L=10 → 5；桥接 triclinicMinHalfSpacing / S29ac 截断诚实。
children.bodyEn: Safe fractional min-image cutoff bound is half min interplanar spacing; cubic → L/2; sample 5; bridges triclinicMinHalfSpacing / S29ac cutoff honesty.

formula.plainZh: 立方三斜盒半最小面间距合成为边长的一半，作为截断诚实上界
formula.plainEn: Cubic triclinic min half-spacing composes as half the edge length for cutoff honesty

children.titleZh: 合成：绝对邻格像数 (2·range+1)³
children.bodyZh: 强剪切下绝对最小镜像在 n∈[−range,range]³ 邻格搜索。算例 range=1 → 27 像；桥接 S29af triclinicAbsoluteLatticeImageCount。
children.bodyEn: Absolute min-image searches n∈[−range,range]³; sample range=1 → 27 images; bridges S29af lattice image count.

formula.plainZh: 绝对最小镜像邻格像数合成为每轴二倍搜索半径加一的立方
formula.plainEn: Absolute min-image lattice image count composes as the cube of twice range plus one

children.titleZh: 合成：静水压 p = Tr(W) / (3 V)
children.titleEn: Compose: hydrostatic pressure p = Tr(W) / (3 V)
children.bodyZh: 三斜应力桩：静水压由维里张量迹与体积合成 p=Tr(W)/(3V)。算例 Wxx=Wyy=Wzz=100、V=1000 → p=0.1；桥接 triclinicPressureShearKpi / S29ah。
children.bodyEn: Triclinic hydrostatic p from virial-trace over 3V; sample diagonals 100, V=1000 → p=0.1; bridges S29ah pressure–shear KPI.

formula.plainZh: 三斜静水压由维里张量迹除以三倍体积合成
formula.plainEn: Triclinic hydrostatic pressure composes as the virial-tensor trace over three times volume

children.titleZh: 合成：各向同性 μ 体积 V′ = μ³ V
children.titleEn: Compose: isotropic μ volume scale V′ = μ³ V
children.bodyZh: h′=μ h 时体积按 μ³ 缩放（分数坐标不变）。算例 μ=1.01、V=1000 → V′≈1030.301；桥接 S29am/S29ap triclinic μ barostat stub。
children.bodyEn: Isotropic h′=μh scales volume by μ³; sample μ=1.01,V=1000; bridges S29am/S29ap μ barostat stub.

vars.mu: 各向同性尺度因子 μ

formula.plainZh: 各向同性 μ 缩放后体积合成为 μ 立方乘原体积
formula.plainEn: Isotropic μ scale composes new volume as μ cubed times the prior volume

children.titleZh: 合成：邻表密度比 n_listed / n_all
children.titleEn: Compose: neighbour-list density ratio n_listed / n_all
children.bodyZh: cell/all-pairs 列表相对全对计数的 meanListRatio。算例 n_listed=12、n_all=45 → 比=0.266…；桥接 triclinicNeighborCountStats / S29ae。
children.bodyEn: meanListRatio = nListed/nAll; sample 12/45; bridges S29ae neighbor-count KPIs.

formula.plainZh: 邻表密度比由列表成对数除以全对成对数合成
formula.plainEn: Neighbour-list density ratio composes listed pairs over all-pairs count

children.titleZh: 合成：剪切范数 ‖s‖ = √(s_xy²+s_xz²+s_yz²)
children.bodyZh: 三斜剪应力 stub 的 Frobenius 型剪切范数。算例 sxy=0.03、sxz=syz=0 → ‖s‖=0.03；桥接 triclinicShearStressStub / dual shear-norm honesty。
children.bodyEn: Shear-stress stub Frobenius-like norm; sample 0.03; bridges shear stub and dual shear-norm honesty.

formula.expr: sn = sqrt(sxy * sxy + sxz * sxz + syz * syz)
formula.plainZh: 三斜剪切范数由三个剪应力分量平方和的平方根合成
formula.plainEn: Triclinic shear norm composes as the square root of the sum of squared off-diagonal stress components

children.titleZh: 合成：各向同性 h 边长 L′ = μ L
children.titleEn: Compose: isotropic h edge L′ = μ L
children.bodyZh: h′=μ h 时立方边长线性缩放，分数坐标不变。算例 μ=1.01、L=10 → L′=10.1；与 μ 体积链 μ³ 并列，桥接 S29am h-matrix μ。
children.bodyEn: Isotropic h′=μh scales edges linearly; sample μ=1.01,L=10 → 10.1; pairs with μ³ volume; bridges S29am h-matrix μ.

vars.mu: 各向同性尺度因子 μ

formula.plainZh: 各向同性 μ 缩放后盒边长合成为 μ 乘原边长
formula.plainEn: Isotropic μ scale composes new box edge as μ times the prior edge

children.titleZh: L0：粒子/势教学叶子
children.bodyZh: 教学可用简化 2-body LJ 演示；不计入 engineering DoD。完整 n-body/PBC / triclinic honesty duals 归 solvers-md（S29 残差 tip，smoke≠eng DoD）。
children.bodyEn: Teaching 2-body demos allowed; eng n-body / triclinic honesty duals live in solvers-md (S29 residual tip; smoke≠eng DoD).

titleZh: 电磁 FDTD Yee3D（工程 kind）
summaryZh: W-Sim BuiltinJobKind em-fdtd-3d：Yee 交错 Maxwell 时域推进；工程路径归 @w-sim/solvers-em-fdtd。
summaryEn: W-Sim kind em-fdtd-3d: Yee staggered Maxwell march; owned by @w-sim/solvers-em-fdtd.

explainRoot.bodyZh: 顶层工程计算方法：在 Yee 网格上交错更新 E/H，闭合 PEC 与吸收边界，输出场与能量 KPI。数值实现归 @w-sim/solvers-em-fdtd。
explainRoot.bodyEn: Yee staggered E/H updates with PEC/ABC; owned by @w-sim/solvers-em-fdtd.

children.titleZh: 原理：Maxwell 与 Yee 交错
children.bodyZh: 无源区 curl E = −∂B/∂t、curl H = ∂D/∂t；Yee 将 E/H 分量放在半格点，中心差分逼近旋度。
children.bodyEn: Source-free curls couple E/H; Yee places components on half-cells for centered curls.

children.titleZh: 基础式：c = 1 / √(μ ε)
children.bodyZh: 均匀介质中光速由介电常数与磁导率决定。真空量级 c₀ ≈ 2.998×10⁸ m/s。
children.bodyEn: Phase speed from μ,ε; vacuum ≈ 2.998e8 m/s.

formula.plainZh: 电磁波速等于磁导率与介电常数乘积开方的倒数
formula.plainEn: Wave speed is the reciprocal square root of μ times ε

children.titleZh: 基础式：Z₀ = √(μ/ε)
children.bodyZh: 平面波中 |E|/|H| ≈ Z。界面反射由阻抗失配决定；工程边界含 PEC / 吸收层。
children.bodyEn: Plane-wave |E|/|H| ≈ Z; mismatch sets reflection.

formula.plainZh: 特征波阻抗等于磁导率除以介电常数再开方
formula.plainEn: Wave impedance is the square root of μ over ε

children.titleZh: 基础：CFL 稳定条件
children.bodyZh: 三维均匀网格上 dt ≤ dx /(c √3) 量级；超 CFL 导致指数发散。工程 smoke 覆盖能量矩阵与 ABC。
children.bodyEn: 3D uniform grid: dt ≤ dx/(c√3) order; smoke covers energy + ABC.

formula.plainZh: 三维 Yee 网格稳定时间步上限约 dx/(c√3)
formula.plainEn: 3D Yee stable dt upper bound is about dx/(c√3)

children.titleZh: 原理：PEC 与吸收边界
children.bodyZh: PEC 切向 E=0 封闭腔体；Mur / CPML 等吸收层近似开放域。compose 金标常看闭腔能量保持与开域泄漏。
children.bodyEn: PEC closes cavities; Mur/CPML approximate open domains.

children.titleZh: 假设与有效域
children.bodyZh: 线性各向同性介质、Yee 二阶精度；色散媒质、亚网格结构、非线性需扩展模型。遗留 fdtd-batch 为 smoke 壳，工程深度在 em-fdtd-3d。
children.bodyEn: Linear isotropic Yee; dispersive/nonlinear need extensions; eng depth on em-fdtd-3d.

children.titleZh: 工程包：solvers-em-fdtd
children.bodyZh: JobKind `em-fdtd-3d` 由 @w-sim/solvers-em-fdtd 拥有；经 kind-matrix 与 lab-kit 登记（ABC eng energy nona-dense CFL residual S27ci + deca-dense CFL residual S27cj landed 等 fixture）。**smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation**。
children.bodyEn: Owned by @w-sim/solvers-em-fdtd; kind-matrix + lab-kit fixtures including ABC eng energy nona-dense CFL residual S27ci + deca-dense CFL residual S27cj landed; smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation.

children.titleZh: 合成视角：Maxwell/Yee ∘ 边界条件 ≈ FDTD 方法
children.bodyZh: 科技树语义：更基础的「Yee/Maxwell（c、Z、CFL、λ、PPW、相速 ω/k、波数 k=ω/c）」与「PEC/ABC / 透射 / nona-dense CFL residual / deca-dense CFL residual」合成应在等价域复现顶层场/能量 KPI（平面波 E/H=Z、H=E/Z、能量密度与电能密度支路、坡印廷合同、CFL 安全比与 dt_max=dx/(c√3)、正入射反射/透射闭合、每波长点数、渡越时间、f=c/λ、nona-dense CFL 排序/plateau/MIN dual、deca-dense CFL 排序/plateau/MIN dual）。对应 principle-bridge `eq-em-yee-pec`；数值 residual tip 桥接 @w-sim/solvers-em-fdtd S27ci nona-dense CFL residual + S27cj deca-dense CFL residual（landed；下接 S27ck）——**smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation**。
children.bodyEn: Composing Yee Maxwell (c,Z,CFL,λ,PPW, phase speed ω/k, k=ω/c) + BC/transmission + nona-dense CFL residual + deca-dense CFL residual should reproduce field/energy KPIs (E/H=Z, H=E/Z, energy density + electric branch, Poynting contract, CFL/dt_max from c, R/T closure, PPW, travel time, f=c/λ, nona-dense CFL ranking/plateau/MIN dual, deca-dense CFL ranking/plateau/MIN dual); see eq-em-yee-pec; bridges @w-sim/solvers-em-fdtd S27ci nona-dense CFL residual + S27cj deca-dense CFL residual (landed; next S27ck) — smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation.

children.titleZh: 合成：平面波 E/H = Z
children.bodyZh: 把介质波阻抗 Z=√(μ/ε) 与场幅合成：均匀介质平面波 |E|/|H|≈Z。工程 smoke 常校验自由空间行波的 E/H 比与 Z₀ 一致。
children.bodyEn: Composes medium Z with fields: progressive plane wave |E|/|H|≈Z; free-space smoke checks E/H vs Z₀.

formula.plainZh: 平面波电场与磁场幅度比等于波阻抗
formula.plainEn: Plane-wave electric-to-magnetic amplitude ratio equals wave impedance

children.titleZh: 合成：电磁能量密度 u = ½(εE² + μH²)
children.titleEn: Compose: EM energy density u = ½(εE² + μH²)
children.bodyZh: 线性无损耗介质瞬时能量密度。闭腔 PEC 下积分 U=∫u dV 在离散能量守恒格式中近似守恒；开域 ABC 则允许能量泄漏。
children.bodyEn: Instantaneous linear lossless energy density; cavity ∫u conserves under discrete energy forms; ABC allows leakage.

formula.expr: u = 0.5 * (eps * E * E + mu * H * H)
formula.plainZh: 线性介质电磁能量密度为电场与磁场储能之和的一半
formula.plainEn: Linear-media EM energy density is half the sum of electric and magnetic stored energy

children.titleZh: 合成：正入射反射 R = (Z₂−Z₁)/(Z₂+Z₁)
children.bodyZh: 把两侧波阻抗与边界语义合成：PEC 极限 Z₂→0 ⇒ R→−1（电场反相）；阻抗匹配 Z₂=Z₁ ⇒ R=0。连接 principle「介质 Z」与「PEC/ABC」。
children.bodyEn: Composes two-sided Z with BC: PEC Z₂→0 ⇒ R→−1; matched Z₂=Z₁ ⇒ R=0; links medium Z to PEC/ABC.

formula.plainZh: 正入射反射系数由两侧波阻抗决定，PEC 极限为 −1
formula.plainEn: Normal-incidence reflection from two impedances; PEC limit is −1

children.titleZh: 合成：匹配校核 Z = √(μ/ε) 与 E/H
children.titleEn: Compose: match check Z=√(μ/ε) vs E/H
children.bodyZh: 介质公式 Z 与场比 E/H 应一致：残差 |E/H − Z|/|Z|。算例 E/H=Z 时残差为 0，构成 Maxwell 介质参数与场观测的合成合同。
children.bodyEn: Medium Z and field ratio E/H must agree; residual |E/H−Z|/|Z|; sample matched → 0.

formula.plainZh: 平面波场比与介质波阻抗的相对残差在匹配时应为零
formula.plainEn: Relative residual between field ratio and medium impedance is zero when matched

children.titleZh: 合成：平面波坡印廷 S = E · H
children.titleEn: Compose: plane-wave Poynting S = E · H
children.bodyZh: 把 E 与 H 合成能流密度量级：均匀介质平面波 |S|≈|E||H|（时均另有 1/2 因子；教学用峰值乘积）。算例 E=377、H=1 → S=377 W/m²，并与 E²/Z 合同。
children.bodyEn: Composes E,H into |S|≈|E||H| peak; sample 377 contracts with E²/Z.

vars.S: 坡印廷能流密度量级 W/m²

formula.plainZh: 平面波坡印廷能流密度量级等于电场与磁场幅度之积
formula.plainEn: Plane-wave Poynting magnitude is the product of electric and magnetic amplitudes

children.titleZh: 合成：S = E² / Z 与 E·H 合同
children.titleEn: Compose: S = E²/Z contracts with E·H
children.bodyZh: 介质阻抗 Z 与电场合成能流：S=E²/Z；当 H=E/Z 时与 E·H 一致。算例 E=377、Z=377 → S=377。
children.bodyEn: S=E²/Z matches E·H when H=E/Z; sample E=Z=377 → S=377.

vars.S: 坡印廷能流密度量级 W/m²

formula.plainZh: 平面波能流可由电场平方除以波阻抗合成，并与 E·H 合同
formula.plainEn: Plane-wave power flux composes as E squared over impedance, matching E·H

children.titleZh: 合成：波长 λ = c / f
children.bodyZh: 把介质光速 c=1/√(με) 与激励频率合成波长，决定每波长网格点数 N_λ=λ/dx（色散/精度 KPI）。算例 c=3e8、f=1e9 → λ=0.3 m。
children.bodyEn: Composes medium c and drive frequency into λ; sets points-per-wavelength KPI; sample 0.3 m at 1 GHz.

formula.plainZh: 波长等于介质光速除以激励频率
formula.plainEn: Wavelength is medium wave speed over drive frequency

children.titleZh: 合成：dt_max = dx √(μ ε) / √3
children.bodyZh: 把介质 μ、ε 与网格 dx 直接合成 CFL 上限：c=1/√(με) ⇒ dt_max=dx/(c√3)=dx√(με)/√3。算例真空 μ0、ε0、dx=1 mm。
children.bodyEn: Composes μ,ε,dx into 3D CFL bound without intermediate c; vacuum sample on 1 mm grid.

formula.plainZh: 三维 Yee 稳定时间步上限由网格与介质 μ、ε 直接合成
formula.plainEn: 3D Yee stable dt upper bound composes grid spacing with medium μ and ε

children.titleZh: 合成：Z = √(μ/ε) 与平面波 E/H
children.bodyZh: 介质参数合成波阻抗，再与场观测并置：Z_med=√(μ/ε) 应等于 E/H。算例真空 μ0/ε0 → Z≈376.7 Ω。
children.bodyEn: Composes medium Z from μ,ε to match E/H; vacuum sample ≈376.7 Ω.

formula.plainZh: 波阻抗由磁导率与介电常数之比开方合成，应对齐平面波 E/H
formula.plainEn: Wave impedance composes as sqrt(μ/ε) and should align with plane-wave E/H

children.titleZh: 合成：c = 1/√(μ ε) 入波推进链
children.titleEn: Compose: c = 1/√(μ ε) into march chain
children.bodyZh: 介质 μ、ε 合成相速 c，再进入 CFL、波长与渡越时间。算例真空 μ0、ε0 → c≈2.998×10⁸ m/s。
children.bodyEn: Composes phase speed c from μ,ε into CFL/λ/travel chains; vacuum sample ≈2.998e8 m/s.

formula.plainZh: 电磁波速由磁导率与介电常数乘积开方的倒数合成，进入 CFL 与波长链
formula.plainEn: EM wave speed composes as 1/√(με) into CFL and wavelength chains

children.titleZh: 合成：H = E / Z 平面波磁场
children.titleEn: Compose: H = E / Z plane-wave magnetic field
children.bodyZh: 把电场与波阻抗合成磁场：H=E/Z，再与 E/H=Z、S=E·H 合同。算例 E=377、Z=377 → H=1 A/m。
children.bodyEn: Composes H=E/Z from E and Z; contracts with E/H=Z and S=E·H; sample H=1 A/m.

formula.plainZh: 平面波磁场幅度由电场除以波阻抗合成
formula.plainEn: Plane-wave magnetic amplitude composes as electric field over impedance

children.titleZh: 合成：正入射压力/电场透射 T = 2 Z₂ / (Z₁ + Z₂)
children.bodyZh: 把两侧波阻抗合成透射系数；匹配 Z₂=Z₁ ⇒ T=1；PEC Z₂→0 ⇒ T→0。与反射 R 并置构成界面合同。算例 Z1=Z2=377 → T=1。
children.bodyEn: Composes two-sided Z into T; matched →1, PEC →0; sits with R as interface contract; sample T=1.

formula.plainZh: 正入射透射系数由两侧波阻抗合成，匹配时为 1
formula.plainEn: Normal-incidence transmission composes from two impedances; matched limit is 1

children.titleZh: 合成：渡越时间 τ = L / c
children.titleEn: Compose: travel time τ = L / c
children.bodyZh: 把路径长度与介质光速合成渡越时间，供时窗/测距 KPI。算例 L=0.3 m、c=3e8 → τ=1 ns。
children.bodyEn: Composes path length and medium c into travel time for window/ranging KPIs; sample 1 ns.

formula.plainZh: 渡越时间等于路径长度除以介质光速
formula.plainEn: Travel time is path length over medium wave speed

children.titleZh: 合成：相速 c_p = ω / k
children.titleEn: Compose: phase speed c_p = ω / k
children.bodyZh: 把角频率与波数合成相速：无色散介质 c_p=ω/k 应等于介质光速 c。算例 ω=2π·1e9、k=ω/3e8 → c_p=3e8，闭合 wavelength 与 c-from-μ-ε 链。
children.bodyEn: Composes ω and k into phase speed; non-dispersive c_p=ω/k equals medium c; sample 3e8 m/s.

formula.plainZh: 无色散介质电磁波相速由角频率除以波数合成，应等于介质光速
formula.plainEn: Non-dispersive EM phase speed composes as angular frequency over wavenumber and equals medium wave speed

children.titleZh: 合成：频率 f = c / λ
children.bodyZh: 把介质光速与波长合成频率：f=c/λ，与 λ=c/f、N_λ=λ/dx 同链。算例 c=3e8、λ=0.3 → f=1e9 Hz，对接 wavelength 与 ppw KPI。
children.bodyEn: Composes c and λ into f=c/λ; sample 3e8/0.3 → 1 GHz; links wavelength and PPW.

formula.plainZh: 电磁波频率由介质光速除以波长合成
formula.plainEn: EM frequency composes as medium wave speed over wavelength

children.titleZh: 合成：CFL 上界 dt_max = dx / (c √3) 入安全比
children.titleEn: Compose: CFL bound dt_max = dx / (c √3) into safety ratio
children.bodyZh: 网格与介质光速先合成 3D Yee 上界 dt_max=dx/(c√3)，再与实际 dt 合成安全比 s=dt/dt_max。与 dt-max-from-μ-ε 对偶（c=1/√(με)）。算例 dx=1 mm、c=3e8。
children.bodyEn: Composes dx and c into 3D Yee dt_max upstream of s=dt/dt_max; dual of dt-max-from-μ-ε; sample dx=1e-3, c=3e8.

formula.plainZh: 三维 Yee 稳定时间步上界由网格间距除以光速再除以√3 合成
formula.plainEn: Three-dimensional Yee max stable time step composes as grid spacing over c times √3

children.titleZh: 合成：波数 k = ω / c 入相速链
children.titleEn: Compose: wavenumber k = ω / c into phase-speed chain
children.bodyZh: 把角频率与介质光速合成波数 k=ω/c，再入 c_p=ω/k 与 λ=2π/k。算例 ω=2π·1e9、c=3e8 → k=ω/c，与 phase-speed 对偶闭合。
children.bodyEn: Composes ω and c into k=ω/c upstream of phase speed and λ=2π/k; sample 1 GHz free-space.

formula.plainZh: 电磁波数由角频率除以介质光速合成，作为相速与波长上游
formula.plainEn: EM wavenumber composes as angular frequency over medium wave speed upstream of phase speed and wavelength

children.titleZh: 合成：电能密度 u_e = ½ ε E²
children.titleEn: Compose: electric energy density u_e = ½ ε E²
children.bodyZh: 把介电常数与电场合成电场储能密度支路 u_e=½εE²，与总能 u=½(εE²+μH²) 同核。算例 ε=ε0、E=√(2/ε0) → u_e=1 J/m³（纯电场瞬间）。
children.bodyEn: Composes ε and E into electric stored-energy branch; sample free-space E chosen so u_e=1 J/m³.

formula.plainZh: 线性介质电场能量密度等于介电常数乘电场平方的一半
formula.plainEn: Linear-media electric energy density is half permittivity times electric field squared

children.titleZh: 合成：角频率 ω = 2 π f 入色散链
children.titleEn: Compose: angular frequency ω = 2 π f into dispersion chain
children.bodyZh: 把激励频率合成角频率 ω=2πf，再进入 k=ω/c 与相速 ω/k。算例 f=1e9 → ω=2π×1e9，对接 wavelength 与 phase-speed。
children.bodyEn: Composes drive frequency into ω=2πf upstream of k and phase speed; sample 1 GHz.

formula.plainZh: 角频率由激励频率乘以 2π 合成，进入波数与相速链
formula.plainEn: Angular frequency composes as 2π times drive frequency into wavenumber and phase-speed chains

children.titleZh: L0：FDTD / 波教学叶子
children.bodyZh: WaveWorld /fdtd 等页可承载教学演示；不计入 engineering DoD。
children.bodyEn: Teaching /fdtd pages allowed; not engineering DoD credit.

titleZh: Mindlin 板 / 结构 FOSD（工程 kind）
summaryZh: W-Sim BuiltinJobKind structural-static：Mindlin–Reissner 一阶剪切可变形板（FOSD）解析/ smoke 路径；工程归 @w-sim/solvers-structural。
summaryEn: W-Sim kind structural-static: Mindlin–Reissner first-order shear-deformable (FOSD) plate path; owned by @w-sim/solvers-structural.

explainRoot.bodyZh: 顶层工程计算方法：在薄→中厚板域用 Mindlin–Reissner 一阶剪切理论（横向位移 w + 独立转动 φ），相对 Kirchhoff 增加横向剪应变自由度。数值/解析 smoke 归 @w-sim/solvers-structural（structural-static）。
explainRoot.bodyEn: Mindlin–Reissner FOSD adds independent rotations and transverse shear vs Kirchhoff; owned by @w-sim/solvers-structural.

children.titleZh: 原理：FOSD 运动学与刚度
children.bodyZh: 板中面法线变形后仍直但不垂直中面：γ_xz ≈ φ_x + ∂w/∂x 等。弯曲刚度由 D，横向剪切刚度 S = κ G t；薄极限 S→∞ 时退回 Kirchhoff。
children.bodyEn: Normals remain straight but not normal to mid-surface; bending D + shear S=κGt; thin limit recovers Kirchhoff.

children.titleZh: 基础式：D = E t³ / (12 (1 − ν²))
children.bodyZh: 各向同性板弯曲刚度（flexural rigidity）。E 杨氏模量，t 厚度，ν 泊松比。要求 |ν|<1、t>0、E>0。
children.bodyEn: Isotropic plate flexural rigidity; require |ν|<1, t>0, E>0.

formula.plainZh: 板弯曲刚度由弹性模量、厚度与泊松比决定
formula.plainEn: Plate flexural rigidity from E, thickness, and Poisson ratio

children.bodyZh: 各向同性剪切模量。Mindlin 横向剪应变能与 G 成正比；与 κ、t 合成为 S。
children.bodyEn: Isotropic shear modulus; transverse shear energy scales with G.

formula.plainZh: 各向同性剪切模量等于 E 除以 2(1+ν)
formula.plainEn: Isotropic shear modulus is E over 2(1+ν)

children.titleZh: 基础式：S = κ G t
children.bodyZh: 横向剪切刚度。κ 为剪切修正因子（矩形截面常取 5/6）。S 越大剪切越硬，越接近 Kirchhoff。
children.bodyEn: Transverse shear stiffness; κ≈5/6 for rectangular section; large S → Kirchhoff.

formula.plainZh: 横向剪切刚度等于剪切修正因子乘剪切模量乘厚度
formula.plainEn: Transverse shear stiffness is κ times G times thickness

children.titleZh: 假设与有效域
children.bodyZh: 线性小挠度、一阶剪切（γ 沿厚均匀）、各向同性或特殊正交各向异性；不含大挠度、塑性、接触与完整 FEM 壳网格。厚板 t/a ≳ 0.2 时剪切超差为 KPI；薄极限 t/a→0 应复现 Kirchhoff。
children.bodyEn: Linear FOSD; no large deflection/plasticity/contact/full shell FEM; thin limit recovers Kirchhoff.

children.titleZh: 原理：Mindlin 相对 Kirchhoff 的剪切软化
children.titleEn: Principle: Mindlin shear softening vs Kirchhoff
children.bodyZh: Navier 级数中 Mindlin 模态幅相对 Kirchhoff 乘剪切因子 (1 + D π² k / S)，k = m²/a² + n²/b²。厚板 |w_M| > |w_K|；薄板 w_M ≈ w_K。
children.bodyEn: Navier Mindlin amplitudes gain factor (1+Dπ²k/S) over Kirchhoff; thick softens, thin matches.

children.titleZh: 基础式：f = 1 + D π² k / S
children.titleEn: Foundation: f = 1 + D π² k / S
children.bodyZh: FOSD 剪切放大因子。W_mn^M = W_mn^K · f。S→∞ 或 t→0 时 f→1，退回薄板 Kirchhoff 级数。
children.bodyEn: FOSD shear amplification; W_mn^M = W_mn^K · f; f→1 recovers Kirchhoff.

formula.plainZh: Mindlin 模态幅相对 Kirchhoff 的剪切放大因子
formula.plainEn: Shear amplification of Mindlin modal amplitude vs Kirchhoff

children.titleZh: 基础式：固支圆板 w_max = q R⁴/(64 D) + q R²/(4 S)
children.titleEn: Foundation: clamped circular w_max = q R⁴/(64 D) + q R²/(4 S)
children.bodyZh: 均匀面压 q 下 Mindlin 固支圆板中心挠度：第一项 Kirchhoff 弯曲，第二项纯剪切。薄极限仅保留 q R⁴/(64 D)。
children.bodyEn: Clamped circular under uniform q: Kirchhoff bend term + pure shear; thin drops shear.

formula.plainZh: 固支圆板中心挠度等于弯曲项与剪切项之和
formula.plainEn: Clamped circular center deflection is bending plus shear terms

children.titleZh: 基础：κ 默认 5/6
children.bodyZh: 矩形截面剪切修正因子常取 κ = 5/6。κ 增大 → S 增大 → 剪切超差减小；工程 smoke 含 κ 扫描残差。
children.bodyEn: Rectangular κ=5/6; larger κ stiffens shear; smoke includes κ sweeps.

formula.plainZh: 矩形截面 Mindlin 默认剪切修正因子为 5/6
formula.plainEn: Default Mindlin shear correction for rectangular section is 5/6

children.titleEn: Compose: Kirchhoff bend ∘ shear correction ≈ Mindlin FOSD
children.bodyZh: 科技树语义：更基础的「弯曲刚度 D / Kirchhoff 级数 / 面密度 ρt / 模态波数 k / 转动惯量 I_ρ」与「横向剪切 S、κ、剪切放大 f、特征长度 ℓ、阻尼 ζ 半功率带宽 Δω、Q 峰因子、长细比 a/t、|w|/能量 peak-factor、双路径 joint 包装、半功率/能量 Q×κ 矩阵、半功率/能量 Q×厚度矩阵、半功率/能量 Q×厚度×κ 矩阵、thickness×κ rotary dual、aspect×κ Q 三元组、aspect×κ rotary dual、aspect×thickness rotary dual、aspect×thickness rotary dual-path honesty、aspect×thickness dual-path expand |w|↔energy packaging、thickness×κ dual-path honesty packaging」合成应在等价域复现顶层 Mindlin 挠度与能量 KPI（薄极限重合、厚板剪切超差、Mindlin 频散降频残差、共振半功率 Q、峰一致性、固支圆弯曲+剪切、κ 灵敏度、SDOF 峰频、joint dual-path max/mean/parity、rotary 降频、Q_w×κ / Q_E×κ / Q 一致性×κ、ω↑κ 单调、Q_w×t / Q_E×t / 厚度单调、Q×t×κ 三元组、rotary↓ω、Q×aspect×κ、Q×aspect×κ rotary、Q×aspect×thickness rotary、dual-path honesty、dual-path expand packaging、thickness×κ dual-path honesty packaging）。对应 foundation 的 D、S、剪切放大因子与固支圆闭式；数值 residual tip 桥接 @w-sim/solvers-structural Mindlin smoke S26bu energy↔peak dual residual packaging + S26bw half-power/energy Q×κ residual + S26bx half-power/energy Q×thickness residual + S26by half-power/energy Q×thickness×κ residual + S26bz Q×thickness×κ rotary dual + aspect×κ residual + S26ca Q×aspect×κ/thickness rotary dual residual + S26cb Q×aspect×thickness rotary dual-path honesty + S26cc dual-path expand |w|↔energy packaging + S26cd thickness×κ dual-path honesty packaging + S26ce thickness×κ dual-path expand |w|↔energy Q packaging（landed；下接 S26cf）——**smoke residual expand ≠ eng DoD / Atlas graduation**。完整 FEM 壳网格仍属 #26/#38 残差。
