children.titleZh: 合成：w_M = w_K · (1 + D π² k / S)
children.titleEn: Compose: w_M = w_K · (1 + D π² k / S)
children.bodyZh: 把 Kirchhoff 模态挠度 w_K 与 FOSD 剪切放大因子合成 Mindlin 幅：W_mn^M = W_mn^K · f，f = 1 + D π² k / S，k = m²/a² + n²/b²。算例 E=210 GPa、t=0.01、a=b=1、m=n=1 → f≈1.00056，剪切略软。
children.bodyEn: Composes Kirchhoff modal w_K with FOSD shear factor f=1+Dπ²k/S into Mindlin amplitude; sample SS plate m=n=1 softens slightly.

formula.expr: w_M = w_K * (1 + D * pi^2 * k / S)
formula.plainZh: Mindlin 挠度由 Kirchhoff 挠度乘以剪切放大因子合成
formula.plainEn: Mindlin deflection composes Kirchhoff deflection times the shear amplification factor

children.titleZh: 合成：D = E t³ / (12 (1 − ν²))
children.bodyZh: 把材料 (E,ν) 与几何 t 合成弯曲刚度 D，作为 Kirchhoff 级数与 Mindlin 剪切因子的公共弯曲支路。算例钢 E=2.1e11、ν=0.3、t=0.01 → D≈1.923×10⁴ N·m。
children.bodyEn: Composes material (E,ν) and thickness into flexural rigidity D shared by Kirchhoff series and Mindlin shear factor.

formula.plainZh: 弯曲刚度由弹性模量、厚度立方与泊松比合成
formula.plainEn: Flexural rigidity composes Young modulus, thickness cubed, and Poisson ratio

children.titleZh: 合成：S = κ G t，G = E / (2 (1 + ν))
children.titleEn: Compose: S = κ G t with G = E / (2 (1 + ν))
children.bodyZh: 把各向同性剪切模量 G=E/(2(1+ν)) 与 κ、t 合成横向剪切刚度 S=κ G t。矩形截面默认 κ=5/6。算例 E=2.1e11、ν=0.3、t=0.01 → S≈6.731×10⁸ N/m。
children.bodyEn: Composes isotropic G from E,ν then S=κGt; rectangular κ=5/6; sample steel plate t=0.01.

formula.plainZh: 横向剪切刚度由剪切修正因子、由 E 与 ν 合成的剪切模量及厚度相乘得到
formula.plainEn: Transverse shear stiffness composes κ, isotropic G from E and ν, and thickness

children.titleZh: 合成：简支板固有频 ω = π² √(D/ρt) · k
children.titleEn: Compose: SS plate natural ω = π² √(D/ρt) · k
children.bodyZh: 把弯曲刚度 D 与面密度 ρt 合成 Kirchhoff 简支矩形板 (m,n) 模态角频率：ω = π² √(D/(ρ t)) (m²/a²+n²/b²)。Mindlin 厚板会再经剪切软化略降频；教学先用薄板合成。算例钢 ρ=7850、t=0.01、a=b=1、m=n=1。
children.bodyEn: Composes D and areal density ρt into SS Kirchhoff modal ω; thick Mindlin softens further; teaching sample steel plate.

formula.plainZh: 简支矩形板固有角频率由弯曲刚度、面密度与模态波数组合合成
formula.plainEn: Simply-supported plate natural frequency composes flexural rigidity, areal density, and modal wave-number sum

children.titleZh: 合成：固支圆板 w_max = q R⁴/(64 D) + q R²/(4 S)
children.titleEn: Compose: clamped circular w_max = q R⁴/(64 D) + q R²/(4 S)
children.bodyZh: 把均布面压 q、半径 R、弯曲刚度 D 与剪切刚度 S 合成 Mindlin 固支圆板中心挠度（弯曲项 + 剪切项）。薄极限仅保留 q R⁴/(64 D)。算例 q=1000、R=0.5、钢 t=0.01。
children.bodyEn: Composes q,R,D,S into clamped circular center deflection (bend+shear); thin drops shear; sample steel plate.

formula.plainZh: 固支圆板中心挠度由弯曲项与剪切项合成
formula.plainEn: Clamped circular center deflection composes bending and shear contributions

children.titleZh: 合成：G = E/(2(1+ν)) 入 S 链
children.titleEn: Compose: G = E/(2(1+ν)) into S chain
children.bodyZh: 材料 (E,ν) 先合成各向同性剪切模量 G，再进入 S=κ G t。算例 E=2.1e11、ν=0.3 → G≈8.077e10 Pa，与 mindlin-compose-S 上游合同。
children.bodyEn: Composes isotropic G from E,ν as upstream of S=κGt; sample steel G≈8.077e10 Pa.

formula.plainZh: 各向同性剪切模量由弹性模量与泊松比合成，作为横向剪切刚度上游
formula.plainEn: Isotropic shear modulus composes from E and ν as upstream of transverse shear stiffness

children.titleZh: 合成：κ = 5/6 矩形截面剪切修正
children.bodyZh: 矩形截面默认剪切修正因子 κ=5/6 直接进入 S=κ G t。与 foundation-kappa 合同；完整截面形函数修正仍属 FEM 残差。
children.bodyEn: Default rectangular shear correction κ=5/6 feeds S=κGt; contracts foundation-kappa; full section-shape κ remains FEM residual.

formula.plainZh: 矩形截面 Mindlin 默认剪切修正因子为 5/6，进入横向剪切刚度合成
formula.plainEn: Default Mindlin shear correction for rectangular section is 5/6 into transverse shear stiffness

children.titleZh: 合成：f = 1 + D π² k / S 剪切放大因子
children.titleEn: Compose: f = 1 + D π² k / S shear amplification
children.bodyZh: 把 D、S 与模态波数 k 合成 FOSD 剪切放大因子 f，再入 w_M=w_K·f 与 ω_M=ω_K/√f。算例钢 t=0.01、a=b=1、m=n=1 → f≈1.00056。
children.bodyEn: Composes D,S,k into FOSD shear factor f upstream of w_M and ω_M; sample thin steel SS plate f≈1.00056.

formula.plainZh: FOSD 剪切放大因子由弯曲刚度、波数组合与横向剪切刚度合成
formula.plainEn: FOSD shear amplification composes flexural rigidity, wave-number sum, and transverse shear stiffness

children.titleZh: 合成：μ = ρ t 面密度入频散链
children.titleEn: Compose: μ = ρ t areal density into dispersion chain
children.bodyZh: 把体密度 ρ 与板厚 t 合成面密度 μ=ρt，再进入 ω∝√(D/μ)。算例钢 ρ=7850、t=0.01 → μ=78.5 kg/m²。
children.bodyEn: Composes bulk density and thickness into areal mass μ upstream of modal ω; sample steel μ=78.5 kg/m².

formula.plainZh: 板面密度由体密度与厚度合成，作为固有频率链的质量侧输入
formula.plainEn: Plate areal density composes from bulk density and thickness as the mass side of the natural-frequency chain

children.titleZh: 合成：ω_M = ω_K / √f Mindlin 剪切软化频
children.titleEn: Compose: ω_M = ω_K / √f Mindlin shear-softened frequency
children.bodyZh: 把 Kirchhoff 模态角频率 ω_K 与剪切放大因子 f 合成 Mindlin 降频：ω_M = ω_K / √f（f=1+Dπ²k/S）。薄板 f→1 ⇒ ω_M→ω_K。算例钢 t=0.01、a=b=1、m=n=1。
children.bodyEn: Composes Kirchhoff ω_K with shear factor f into Mindlin ω_M=ω_K/√f; thin f→1 recovers Kirchhoff; sample steel plate.

formula.plainZh: Mindlin 模态角频率由 Kirchhoff 频率除以剪切放大因子的平方根合成
formula.plainEn: Mindlin modal frequency composes as Kirchhoff frequency over square root of the shear amplification factor

children.titleZh: 合成：共振峰因子 Q = 1/(2 ζ)
children.titleEn: Compose: resonance peak factor Q = 1/(2 ζ)
children.bodyZh: 把模态阻尼比 ζ 合成 forced-harmonic 共振位移放大峰 Q≈1/(2ζ)。算例 ζ=0.05 → Q=10；与 Mindlin 模态刚度链并列教学，完整 forced-harmonic smoke 归 solvers-structural。
children.bodyEn: Composes modal damping ζ into resonance peak Q≈1/(2ζ); sample ζ=0.05 → Q=10; full forced-harmonic smoke in solvers-structural.

formula.plainZh: 小阻尼共振峰位移放大因子由阻尼比合成，约等于 1/(2ζ)
formula.plainEn: Lightly damped resonance displacement peak composes from damping ratio as about 1/(2ζ)

children.titleZh: 合成：特征长度 ℓ = √(D/S) 剪切尺度
children.titleEn: Compose: characteristic length ℓ = √(D/S) shear scale
children.bodyZh: 把弯曲刚度 D 与剪切刚度 S 合成剪切特征长度 ℓ=√(D/S)。因 D∝t³、S∝t，ℓ∝t；与波长/边长比衡量剪切软化强弱。算例钢 t=0.01 → ℓ≈√(D/S)。
children.bodyEn: Composes D and S into shear length ℓ=√(D/S)∝t; ratio to span gauges shear softening; sample steel t=0.01.

formula.plainZh: 剪切特征长度由弯曲刚度与横向剪切刚度之比开方合成，尺度与板厚同阶
formula.plainEn: Shear characteristic length composes as square root of D over S and scales with plate thickness

children.titleZh: 合成：k = m²/a² + n²/b² 模态波数
children.titleEn: Compose: k = m²/a² + n²/b² modal wave-number sum
children.bodyZh: 把简支矩形板模态指标 (m,n) 与边长 a,b 合成波数组合 k，进入 f、ω 与超差链。算例 m=n=1、a=b=1 → k=2。
children.bodyEn: Composes SS plate mode indices (m,n) and spans into k upstream of f, ω, excess; sample m=n=1,a=b=1 → k=2.

formula.plainZh: 简支板模态波数组合由半波数平方除以边长平方再相加合成
formula.plainEn: Simply-supported modal wave-number sum composes half-wave indices squared over span squares

children.titleZh: 合成：D/S = ℓ² 弯曲–剪切比
children.bodyZh: 弯曲与横向剪切刚度之比等于剪切特征长度平方。算例钢 t=0.01 → D/S = ℓ²，与 mindlin-compose-char-length 合同。
children.bodyEn: Ratio D/S equals shear length squared; sample steel t=0.01 contracts char-length.

formula.plainZh: 弯曲–剪切刚度比等于特征长度平方，连接 D、S 与 f 放大链
formula.plainEn: Bend–shear stiffness ratio equals characteristic length squared, linking D, S, and the f amplification chain

children.titleZh: 合成：f = 1 + π² k ℓ² 由特征长度
children.titleEn: Compose: f = 1 + π² k ℓ² from shear length
children.bodyZh: 因 ℓ²=D/S，剪切放大 f=1+Dπ²k/S = 1+π²kℓ²。算例钢 t=0.01、k=2 → 与 mindlin-compose-f-shear 合同。
children.bodyEn: With ℓ²=D/S, f=1+π²kℓ²; sample steel t=0.01,k=2 contracts f-shear.

formula.plainZh: 剪切放大因子由模态波数与剪切特征长度平方合成，等价于 Dπ²k/S
formula.plainEn: Shear amplification composes from modal wave-number and shear length squared, equivalent to Dπ²k/S

children.titleZh: 合成：I_ρ = ρ t³/12 转动惯量面密度
children.titleEn: Compose: I_ρ = ρ t³/12 rotary inertia density
children.bodyZh: 把体密度 ρ 与厚度 t 合成 Mindlin 转动惯量面密度 I_ρ=ρ t³/12（均匀板）。厚板动力学 rotary dual 残差链入门；完整 forced-harmonic rotary tip 归 solvers-structural（S26bq 等）。算例钢 ρ=7850、t=0.01。
children.bodyEn: Composes bulk density and thickness into Mindlin rotary inertia density I_ρ=ρt³/12; thick-plate rotary dual residual entry; full tip in solvers-structural (S26bq family).

formula.plainZh: Mindlin 转动惯量面密度由体密度与厚度立方合成，作为 rotary dual 残差上游
formula.plainEn: Mindlin rotary inertia density composes from bulk density and thickness cubed as upstream of rotary dual residuals

children.titleZh: 合成：Δω = 2 ζ ω 半功率带宽
children.titleEn: Compose: Δω = 2 ζ ω half-power bandwidth
children.bodyZh: 把模态阻尼比 ζ 与固有角频率 ω 合成半功率带宽 Δω≈2ζω（=ω/Q）。桥接 S26bd/S26bq half-power residual 教学入口；算例 ζ=0.05、ω=100 → Δω=10 rad/s。
children.bodyEn: Composes ζ and ω into half-power bandwidth Δω≈2ζω (=ω/Q); bridges S26bd/S26bq half-power residual teaching; sample 10 rad/s.

formula.plainZh: 半功率带宽由阻尼比与固有角频率合成，约等于 2ζω
formula.plainEn: Half-power bandwidth composes from damping ratio and natural frequency as about 2ζω

children.titleZh: 合成：Δω/ω = 1/Q = 2 ζ 相对带宽
children.bodyZh: 相对半功率带宽等于 1/Q 或 2ζ。算例 Q=10 → 相对带宽 0.1，与 mindlin-compose-zeta-peak 合同。
children.bodyEn: Relative half-power bandwidth is 1/Q or 2ζ; sample Q=10 → 0.1 contracts zeta-peak.

formula.plainZh: 相对半功率带宽等于共振放大因子的倒数，也等于 2ζ
formula.plainEn: Relative half-power bandwidth is the reciprocal of resonance Q and equals 2ζ

children.titleZh: 合成：Q = ω / Δω 由半功率带宽
children.titleEn: Compose: Q = ω / Δω from half-power bandwidth
children.bodyZh: 把固有频与半功率带宽反推 Q。算例 ω=100、Δω=10 → Q=10，与 1/(2ζ) 峰因子合同；对应 half-power Δω/Q residual 教学。
children.bodyEn: Inverts ω and Δω into Q; sample 100/10=10 contracts 1/(2ζ); half-power Δω/Q residual teaching.

formula.plainZh: 共振放大因子由固有角频率除以半功率带宽合成
formula.plainEn: Resonance Q composes as natural frequency over half-power bandwidth

children.titleZh: 合成：w_b = q R⁴/(64 D) 纯弯曲项
children.titleEn: Compose: w_b = q R⁴/(64 D) pure bending term
children.bodyZh: 固支圆板中心挠度的 Kirchhoff 弯曲支路。算例 q=1000、R=0.5、钢 t=0.01；与 mindlin-compose-circ-w 弯曲分量合同。
children.bodyEn: Kirchhoff bend branch of clamped circular center deflection; sample contracts circ-w bend term.

formula.plainZh: 固支圆板纯弯曲挠度由面压、半径四次方与弯曲刚度合成
formula.plainEn: Clamped circular pure bending deflection composes pressure, radius to the fourth, and flexural rigidity

children.titleZh: 合成：w_s = q R²/(4 S) 纯剪切项
children.titleEn: Compose: w_s = q R²/(4 S) pure shear term
children.bodyZh: 固支圆板中心挠度的 FOSD 纯剪切支路。算例 q=1000、R=0.5、钢 t=0.01；与 mindlin-compose-shear-fraction 上游合同。
children.bodyEn: FOSD pure shear branch of clamped circular center deflection; sample contracts shear-fraction upstream.

formula.plainZh: 固支圆板纯剪切挠度由面压、半径平方与横向剪切刚度合成
formula.plainEn: Clamped circular pure shear deflection composes pressure, radius squared, and transverse shear stiffness

children.titleZh: 合成：ω = π² √(D/μ) · k 面密度形
children.titleEn: Compose: ω = π² √(D/μ) · k with areal mass
children.bodyZh: 把 μ=ρt 与 D、k 合成 Kirchhoff 简支板 ω（面密度形，与 mindlin-compose-omega 等价）。算例钢 μ=78.5、t=0.01、k=2。
children.bodyEn: Composes areal mass μ with D,k into SS Kirchhoff ω; equivalent to rho·t form; sample steel μ=78.5,k=2.

formula.plainZh: 简支板固有角频率由弯曲刚度、面密度与模态波数合成（面密度形）
formula.plainEn: Simply-supported plate natural frequency composes flexural rigidity, areal mass, and modal wave-number (areal-mass form)

children.titleZh: 合成：p = |amp| · 2 ζ 峰因子（相对 SDOF）
children.titleEn: Compose: p = |amp| · 2 ζ peak factor vs SDOF
children.bodyZh: S26ba/S26bu 峰因子：把位移峰放大 |amp| 与阻尼 ζ 合成 p=|amp|·2ζ；基频主导时 p≈1。算例 |amp|=10、ζ=0.05 → p=1；与 mindlin-compose-zeta-peak 对偶。桥接 S26bu dual-path peak-factor envelope。
children.bodyEn: Peak factor p=|amp|·2ζ vs SDOF; fund-dom → p≈1; sample |amp|=10, ζ=0.05 → 1; dual of zeta-peak; bridges S26bu dual-path peak-factor envelope.

formula.plainZh: 峰因子等于共振峰放大与两倍阻尼比之积，基频主导时约等于 1
formula.plainEn: Peak factor is resonance amplification times twice the damping ratio; near 1 under fund domination

children.titleZh: 合成：p_E = |amp_E| · 2 ζ 能量峰因子
children.titleEn: Compose: p_E = |amp_E| · 2 ζ energy peak factor
children.bodyZh: 能量支路峰因子：模态 |H| 能量放大 |amp_E| 与 2ζ 合成 p_E。算例 |amp_E|=10、ζ=0.05 → p_E=1；与 p_w 匹配时 S26bu |w|↔energy consistency 残差→0。
children.bodyEn: Energy-path peak factor p_E=|amp_E|·2ζ; sample 10×0.1=1; matched with p_w yields S26bu |w|↔energy consistency residual 0.

formula.plainZh: 能量峰因子等于能量支路峰放大与两倍阻尼比之积
formula.plainEn: Energy peak factor is energy-path peak amplification times twice the damping ratio

children.titleZh: 合成：Q_E = 1/(2 ζ) 能量半功率 Q
children.titleEn: Compose: Q_E = 1/(2 ζ) energy half-power Q
children.bodyZh: 能量半功率带宽定义 Q_E=ω_1/Δω_E≈1/(2ζ)。算例 ζ=0.05 → Q_E=10；与 mindlin-compose-zeta-peak 位移 Q 同构。桥接 S26be/S26bu energy half-power。
children.bodyEn: Energy half-power Q_E≈1/(2ζ); sample ζ=0.05 → 10; isomorphic to displacement Q; bridges S26be/S26bu.

formula.plainZh: 能量半功率品质因子由阻尼比合成，约等于 1/(2ζ)
formula.plainEn: Energy half-power quality factor composes from damping ratio as about 1/(2ζ)

children.titleZh: 合成：ω_p = ω_n √(1 − 2 ζ²) SDOF 位移峰频
children.titleEn: Compose: ω_p = ω_n √(1 − 2 ζ²) SDOF displacement peak freq
children.bodyZh: S26bi SDOF 位移 FRF 峰频恒等：ω_p/ω_n=√(1−2ζ²)（ζ<1/√2）。算例 ω_n=100、ζ=0.05 → ω_p=100√0.995。桥接 S26bu peak-frequency identity。
children.bodyEn: SDOF displacement peak ω_p=ω_n√(1−2ζ²); sample ω_n=100, ζ=0.05 → 100√0.995; bridges S26bu peak-frequency identity.

formula.plainZh: SDOF 位移响应峰角频率由固有频率与阻尼比经 √(1−2ζ²) 合成
formula.plainEn: SDOF displacement-response peak angular frequency composes from natural frequency and damping via √(1−2ζ²)

children.titleZh: 合成：d_w = dualPathMaxPeakFactorAbsDiff_|w|
children.bodyZh: S26bt |w| 双路径 expand：noRotary∪withRotary 上 |p_w−p_E| 最大绝对差。教学金标诚实包 d_w→0。算例匹配包 d_w=0；桥接 S26bu wExpand。
children.bodyEn: S26bt |w| dual-path expand max |p_w−p_E| over noRotary∪withRotary; honest pack d_w→0; sample 0; bridges S26bu wExpand.

vars.d_w: |w| 双路径峰因子最大绝对差 1

formula.plainZh: |w| 双路径峰因子最大绝对差直接取 dual-path expand KPI
formula.plainEn: |w| dual-path max peak-factor absolute difference is the dual-path expand KPI

children.titleZh: 合成：d_E = dualPathMaxPeakFactorAbsDiff_E
children.bodyZh: S26bt 能量双路径 expand 对偶：energy 路径上 max |p_w−p_E|。算例匹配包 d_E=0；与 d_w 配对进入 joint packaging。桥接 S26bu energyExpand。
children.bodyEn: S26bt energy dual-path expand max |p_w−p_E|; sample 0; pairs with d_w into joint packaging; bridges S26bu energyExpand.

vars.d_E: 能量双路径峰因子最大绝对差 1

formula.plainZh: 能量双路径峰因子最大绝对差直接取 energy dual-path expand KPI
formula.plainEn: Energy dual-path max peak-factor absolute difference is the energy dual-path expand KPI

children.titleZh: 合成：Δω = ω_no − ω_rot 转动惯量降频
children.titleEn: Compose: Δω = ω_no − ω_rot rotary inertia frequency drop
children.bodyZh: S26bu joint rotary：每个 aspect×thickness 单元 withRotary 基频低于 noRotary。算例 ω_no=100、ω_rot=98 → Δω=2>0。桥接 jointRotaryLowersOmegaAtEveryCell。
children.bodyEn: S26bu joint rotary: withRotary ω_1 < noRotary at every cell; sample 100−98=2; bridges jointRotaryLowersOmegaAtEveryCell.

vars.delta_omega: 转动惯量引起的基频降 rad/s

formula.plainZh: 转动惯量降频等于无转动基频减去含转动基频，诚实时为正
formula.plainEn: Rotary frequency drop is no-rotary fundamental minus with-rotary; honesty requires positive drop

children.titleZh: 合成：Q_w(κ) = 1/(2 ζ) 半功率 Q × κ
children.titleEn: Compose: Q_w(κ) = 1/(2 ζ) half-power Q × κ
children.bodyZh: S26bw |w| 半功率 Q×κ：小阻尼 Q_w≈1/(2ζ) 在每个 κ 上 eng 诚实。算例 ζ=0.05 → Q_w=10（与 κ 解耦教学入口）；完整 κ 表归 solvers-structural。
children.bodyEn: S26bw |w| half-power Q×κ: Q_w≈1/(2ζ) eng-honest at every κ; sample ζ=0.05 → 10; full κ table in solvers-structural.

vars.kappa: 剪切修正因子 κ（表参数）

formula.plainZh: 位移半功率品质因子在小阻尼下由阻尼比合成，κ 表上应保持 eng 诚实
formula.plainEn: Displacement half-power Q composes from damping under light damping and stays eng-honest across the κ table

children.titleZh: 合成：Q_E(κ) = 1/(2 ζ) 能量半功率 Q × κ
children.titleEn: Compose: Q_E(κ) = 1/(2 ζ) energy half-power Q × κ
children.bodyZh: S26bw 能量半功率 Q×κ 对偶：Q_E≈1/(2ζ) 在每个 κ 上与 Q_w 同构。算例 ζ=0.05 → Q_E=10；桥接 |w|↔energy Q consistency × κ。
children.bodyEn: S26bw energy half-power Q×κ dual of Q_w; sample ζ=0.05 → 10; bridges |w|↔energy Q consistency × κ.

vars.kappa: 剪切修正因子 κ（表参数）

formula.plainZh: 能量半功率品质因子在 κ 表上由阻尼比合成，应与位移 Q 同构
formula.plainEn: Energy half-power Q composes from damping on the κ table and should match displacement Q

children.titleZh: 合成：S(κ) = κ G t 横向剪切刚度 × κ
children.titleEn: Compose: S(κ) = κ G t transverse shear stiffness × κ
children.bodyZh: S26bw κ 扫描上游：S=κ G t。算例 κ=5/6、G=E/(2(1+ν))、E=2.1e11、ν=0.3、t=0.2 → S=κ G t。
children.bodyEn: Upstream of S26bw κ sweep: S=κGt; sample thick t=0.2 steel with κ=5/6.

formula.plainZh: 横向剪切刚度由剪切修正因子、剪切模量与厚度合成
formula.plainEn: Transverse shear stiffness composes shear correction, shear modulus, and thickness

children.titleZh: 合成：f(κ) = 1 + D π² k / (κ G t) 剪切放大 × κ
children.titleEn: Compose: f(κ) = 1 + D π² k / (κ G t) shear factor × κ
children.bodyZh: 把 κ 直接写入剪切放大：f=1+Dπ²k/S、S=κGt。κ↑ ⇒ f↓ ⇒ 更接近 Kirchhoff。算例示意 f−1 与 1/κ 成正比。
children.bodyEn: Shear factor writes κ via S=κGt; κ↑ ⇒ f↓ toward Kirchhoff; sample f−1 ∝ 1/κ.

formula.expr: f = 1 + D * pi * pi * k / (kappa * G * t)
formula.plainZh: 剪切放大因子由弯曲刚度、波数与 κ 依赖的横向剪切刚度合成
formula.plainEn: Shear amplification composes flexural rigidity, wave-number, and κ-dependent transverse shear stiffness

children.titleZh: 合成：Q_w(t) = 1/(2 ζ) 半功率 Q × 厚度
children.titleEn: Compose: Q_w(t) = 1/(2 ζ) half-power Q × thickness
children.bodyZh: S26bx |w| 半功率 Q×厚度：小阻尼 Q_w≈1/(2ζ) 在厚度表上 eng 诚实。算例 ζ=0.05 → Q_w=10（与 t 解耦教学入口）；完整 t 表归 solvers-structural。
children.bodyEn: S26bx |w| half-power Q×thickness: Q_w≈1/(2ζ) eng-honest on t-table; sample ζ=0.05 → 10; full t table in solvers-structural.

formula.plainZh: 位移半功率品质因子在小阻尼下由阻尼比合成，厚度表上应保持 eng 诚实
formula.plainEn: Displacement half-power Q composes from damping under light damping and stays eng-honest across the thickness table

children.titleZh: 合成：Q_E(t) = 1/(2 ζ) 能量半功率 Q × 厚度
children.titleEn: Compose: Q_E(t) = 1/(2 ζ) energy half-power Q × thickness
children.bodyZh: S26bx 能量半功率 Q×厚度对偶：Q_E≈1/(2ζ) 在每个 t 上与 Q_w 同构。算例 ζ=0.05 → Q_E=10；桥接 |w|↔energy Q consistency × t。
children.bodyEn: S26bx energy half-power Q×thickness dual of Q_w; sample ζ=0.05 → 10; bridges |w|↔energy Q consistency × t.

formula.plainZh: 能量半功率品质因子在厚度表上由阻尼比合成，应与位移 Q 同构
formula.plainEn: Energy half-power Q composes from damping on the thickness table and should match displacement Q

children.titleZh: 合成：S(t) = κ G t 横向剪切刚度 × 厚度
children.titleEn: Compose: S(t) = κ G t transverse shear stiffness × thickness
children.bodyZh: S26bx 厚度扫描上游：S=κ G t 线性于 t。算例 κ=5/6、G=E/(2(1+ν))、E=2.1e11、ν=0.3、t=0.1 → S=κ G t。
children.bodyEn: Upstream of S26bx t sweep: S=κGt linear in t; sample thin-ish t=0.1 steel with κ=5/6.

formula.plainZh: 横向剪切刚度由剪切修正因子、剪切模量与厚度合成（厚度表扫描）
formula.plainEn: Transverse shear stiffness composes shear correction, shear modulus, and thickness on the t table

children.titleZh: 合成：D(t) = E t³ / (12(1−ν²)) 弯曲刚度 × 厚度
children.titleEn: Compose: D(t) = E t³ / (12(1−ν²)) flexural rigidity × thickness
children.bodyZh: S26bx 厚度³ 律：弯曲刚度 D∝t³。算例 E=2.1e11、ν=0.3、t=0.1 → D=E t³/(12(1−ν²))；与 S∝t 组成薄/厚剪切相对强度。
children.bodyEn: S26bx thickness cube law D∝t³; sample E=2.1e11, ν=0.3, t=0.1; pairs with S∝t for thin/thick shear relative strength.

formula.plainZh: 弯曲刚度由杨氏模量与厚度三次方合成，分母为泊松修正
formula.plainEn: Flexural rigidity composes Young modulus and thickness cubed over the Poisson factor

children.titleZh: 合成：φ_s(t) = w_s / (w_b + w_s) 剪切挠度占比 × 厚度
children.titleEn: Compose: φ_s(t) = w_s / (w_b + w_s) shear deflection fraction × thickness
children.bodyZh: S26bx 厚板剪切占比：w_s/(w_b+w_s)。算例 w_b=0.8、w_s=0.2 → φ_s=0.2；t↑ 通常 φ_s↑，桥接 thick residual。
children.bodyEn: S26bx thick shear fraction w_s/(w_b+w_s); sample 0.2/1=0.2; t↑ usually φ_s↑; bridges thick residual.

formula.plainZh: 剪切挠度占比等于剪切贡献除以弯曲与剪切贡献之和
formula.plainEn: Shear deflection fraction is shear contribution over bend plus shear contributions

children.titleZh: 合成：Q_w(t,κ) = 1/(2 ζ) 半功率 Q × 厚度×κ
children.titleEn: Compose: Q_w(t,κ) = 1/(2 ζ) half-power Q × thickness×κ
children.bodyZh: S26by |w| 半功率 Q×厚度×κ：小阻尼 Q_w≈1/(2ζ) 在 t×κ 矩阵上 eng 诚实。算例 ζ=0.05 → Q_w=10（与 t、κ 解耦教学入口）；完整矩阵归 solvers-structural。
children.bodyEn: S26by |w| half-power Q×thickness×κ: Q_w≈1/(2ζ) eng-honest on t×κ matrix; sample ζ=0.05 → 10; full matrix in solvers-structural.

vars.kappa: 剪切修正因子 κ（表参数）

formula.plainZh: 位移半功率品质因子在小阻尼下由阻尼比合成，厚度×κ 矩阵上应保持 eng 诚实
formula.plainEn: Displacement half-power Q composes from damping under light damping and stays eng-honest across the thickness×κ matrix

children.titleZh: 合成：Q_E(t,κ) = 1/(2 ζ) 能量半功率 Q × 厚度×κ
children.titleEn: Compose: Q_E(t,κ) = 1/(2 ζ) energy half-power Q × thickness×κ
children.bodyZh: S26by 能量半功率 Q×厚度×κ 对偶：Q_E≈1/(2ζ) 在每个 (t,κ) 上与 Q_w 同构。算例 ζ=0.05 → Q_E=10；桥接 |w|↔energy Q consistency × t×κ。
children.bodyEn: S26by energy half-power Q×thickness×κ dual of Q_w; sample ζ=0.05 → 10; bridges |w|↔energy Q consistency × t×κ.

vars.kappa: 剪切修正因子 κ（表参数）

formula.plainZh: 能量半功率品质因子在厚度×κ 矩阵上由阻尼比合成，应与位移 Q 同构
formula.plainEn: Energy half-power Q composes from damping on the thickness×κ matrix and should match displacement Q

children.titleZh: 合成：S(t,κ) = κ G t 横向剪切刚度 × 厚度×κ
children.titleEn: Compose: S(t,κ) = κ G t transverse shear stiffness × thickness×κ
children.bodyZh: S26by 厚度×κ 扫描上游：S=κ G t 双线性于 t 与 κ。算例 κ=5/6、G=E/(2(1+ν))、E=2.1e11、ν=0.3、t=0.1 → S=κ G t。
children.bodyEn: Upstream of S26by t×κ sweep: S=κGt bilinear in t and κ; sample t=0.1 steel with κ=5/6.

formula.plainZh: 横向剪切刚度由剪切修正因子、剪切模量与厚度合成（厚度×κ 矩阵扫描）
formula.plainEn: Transverse shear stiffness composes shear correction, shear modulus, and thickness on the t×κ matrix

children.titleZh: L0：板弯曲 / 剪切教学叶子
children.bodyZh: 教学可用单式 D、S 与固支圆闭式演示薄/厚差；不计入 engineering DoD。完整 Mindlin Navier / FEM 归 solvers-structural。
children.bodyEn: Teaching D/S and circular closed form allowed; eng Mindlin path lives in solvers-structural.

titleZh: 路径实验 / 光敏动力学（工程 kind）
summaryZh: W-Sim BuiltinJobKind path-experiment：Jablonski 三线态→ROS 速率方程 + RK4/稳态对拍 + 不确定性/技能分残差链；工程路径归 @w-sim/solvers-path-experiment（smoke，未 Atlas 毕业）。
summaryEn: W-Sim kind path-experiment: Jablonski T1→ROS ODEs + RK4/steady gold + uncertainty/skill residual chain; owned by @w-sim/solvers-path-experiment (smoke, not Atlas-graduated).

explainRoot.titleZh: 方法：路径实验 / 光敏动力学
explainRoot.bodyZh: 顶层工程计算方法：给定 Jablonski 速率与氧/底物池，积分敏化剂电子态与 ¹O2 池，输出稳态占比、生成率与不确定性 KPI。数值核心在 WaveWorld photosensitization（RK4 + 解析稳态）与 @w-sim/solvers-path-experiment 残差链。
explainRoot.bodyEn: Integrate Jablonski electronic states + ¹O2 pool; KPIs from steady φ_T, generation, and uncertainty/skill residuals; solvers-path-experiment owns eng path.

children.titleZh: 原理：Jablonski 速率与解析稳态
children.titleEn: Principle: Jablonski rates & analytic steady state
children.bodyZh: S0↔S1↔T1 循环 + Type II 能量转移生成 ¹O2。令 k_T,eff、a、b 后稳态闭式：S0_ss、S1_ss、T1_ss、¹O2_ss 与守恒 S0+S1+T1=C_tot。
children.bodyEn: S0↔S1↔T1 cycle + Type II → ¹O2; closed steady state via k_T,eff, a, b; conservation of sensitizer.

children.titleZh: 基础式：k_T,eff = k_T + k_q [³O2] + k_I [sub]
children.bodyZh: T1 总失活伪一级率：氧无关磷光/失活 + Type II 猝灭 + Type I 底物道。默认算例 k_T,eff = 0.2+1.5+0.3 = 2。
children.bodyEn: Pseudo-first-order T1 loss: O2-independent + Type II + Type I; sample defaults → 2.

formula.expr: kTeff = k_T + k_q * O2 + k_I * substrate
formula.plainZh: 三线态总失活率等于氧无关、Type II 与 Type I 三道伪一级率之和
formula.plainEn: Triplet total decay is the sum of O2-independent, Type II, and Type I rates

children.titleZh: 基础式：a = k_exc / (k_f + k_isc)
children.bodyZh: S1 稳态相对 S0 的分支比：激发率相对 S1 总出射（荧光/内转换 + ISC）。默认 a = 0.5/5 = 0.1。
children.bodyEn: Steady S1/S0 branch ratio; sample a = 0.5/5 = 0.1.

formula.plainZh: 稳态参数 a 等于激发率除以 S1 总出射率
formula.plainEn: Steady parameter a is excitation over total S1 outflow

children.titleZh: 基础式：b = k_isc / k_T,eff
children.bodyZh: T1 相对 S1 的稳态比参数：ISC 进料相对 T1 总失活。默认 b = 3/2 = 1.5。
children.bodyEn: Steady T1/S1 parameter; sample b = 3/2 = 1.5.

formula.plainZh: 稳态参数 b 等于 ISC 率除以 T1 总失活率
formula.plainEn: Steady parameter b is ISC rate over total T1 decay

children.titleZh: 基础式：S0_ss = C_tot / (1 + a + a b)
children.titleEn: Foundation: S0_ss = C_tot / (1 + a + a b)
children.bodyZh: 基态稳态浓度。默认 C_tot=1、a=0.1、b=1.5 → 分母 1.25 → S0_ss=0.8。
children.bodyEn: Steady ground state; defaults → S0_ss = 0.8.

formula.plainZh: 基态稳态浓度由总敏化剂与 a、b 分支参数决定
formula.plainEn: Steady S0 from total sensitizer and branch parameters a, b

children.titleZh: 基础式：S1_ss = a · S0_ss
children.bodyZh: 单线态激发态稳态。默认 a·0.8 = 0.08。
children.bodyEn: Steady S1 = a S0; sample 0.08.

formula.plainZh: S1 稳态浓度等于参数 a 乘基态稳态浓度
formula.plainEn: Steady S1 equals a times steady S0

children.titleZh: 基础式：T1_ss = a b · S0_ss
children.bodyEn: Steady T1 = a b S0; sample 0.12.

formula.plainZh: T1 稳态浓度等于 a b 乘基态稳态浓度
formula.plainEn: Steady T1 equals a times b times steady S0

children.titleZh: 基础式：φ_T,ss = T1_ss / C_tot
children.bodyZh: 稳态三线态占比。默认 T1_ss/C_tot = 0.12。亦可写 φ_T = a b / (1+a+a b)。
children.bodyEn: Steady triplet fraction; sample 0.12; equiv. ab/(1+a+ab).

formula.plainZh: 稳态三线态占比等于 T1 稳态浓度除以总敏化剂
formula.plainEn: Steady triplet fraction is T1_ss over total sensitizer

children.titleZh: 基础式：G_ss = k_q [³O2] T1_ss
children.bodyEn: Steady ¹O2 generation; sample 0.18.

formula.plainZh: 稳态单线态氧生成率等于 Type II 猝灭率乘 T1 稳态浓度
formula.plainEn: Steady ¹O2 generation is Type II quench rate times steady T1

children.titleZh: 基础式：¹O2_ss = G_ss / k_d
children.bodyZh: 单线态氧池稳态：生成与衰减平衡。默认 0.18/5 = 0.036。
children.bodyEn: Steady ¹O2 pool G/k_d; sample 0.036.

formula.plainZh: 单线态氧稳态浓度等于生成率除以衰减率
formula.plainEn: Steady ¹O2 concentration is generation over decay rate

children.titleZh: 基础：守恒 S0 + S1 + T1 = C_tot
children.titleEn: Foundation: conservation S0 + S1 + T1 = C_tot
children.bodyZh: 敏化剂在三电子态间循环，¹O2 自成一池。默认稳态 0.8+0.08+0.12 = 1。
children.bodyEn: Sensitizer conserved across electronic states; ¹O2 separate; sample sum=1.

formula.plainZh: 敏化剂三电子态浓度之和等于总浓度守恒量
formula.plainEn: Sum of three electronic-state concentrations equals total sensitizer

children.titleZh: 假设与有效域
children.bodyZh: 伪一级氧/底物池、Type II 为主、线性速率；不含完整 PDT 组织光传输、耗氧耦合或药代。工程 smoke 以 RK4 末态对解析稳态 + 不确定性/技能分残差链（S20h…S20aj）为护栏，非 eng-complete / 未 Atlas 毕业。
children.bodyEn: Pseudo-first-order pools, Type-II-led linear rates; no full tissue optics/PK; smoke = RK4 vs steady + skill residual chain, not eng-complete.

children.titleZh: 原理：T1 分支 Type II / Type I / 失活
children.titleEn: Principle: T1 branches Type II / Type I / deactivation
children.bodyZh: T1 去激三道伪一级率归一：氧 ↑ 抬升 Type II 占比并抢占 Type I 与氧无关失活。
children.bodyEn: Normalized T1 exit channels; higher O2 raises Type II share.

children.titleZh: 基础式：f_II = k_q [³O2] / k_T,eff
children.bodyZh: Type II 分支占比。默认 1.5/2 = 0.75。
children.bodyEn: Type II branch fraction; sample 0.75.

formula.plainEn: Type II branch fraction is O2 quench rate over total T1 decay

children.titleZh: 基础式：f_I = k_I [sub] / k_T,eff
children.bodyZh: Type I 分支占比。默认 0.3/2 = 0.15。
children.bodyEn: Type I branch fraction; sample 0.15.

formula.plainZh: Type I 分支占比等于底物道伪一级率除以 T1 总失活率
formula.plainEn: Type I branch fraction is substrate channel over total T1 decay

children.titleZh: 基础式：f_d = k_T / k_T,eff
children.bodyZh: 氧无关失活分支占比。默认 0.2/2 = 0.1。
children.bodyEn: O2-independent deactivation fraction; sample 0.1.

formula.plainZh: 氧无关失活分支占比等于 k_T 除以 T1 总失活率
formula.plainEn: Deactivation branch fraction is k_T over total T1 decay

children.titleZh: 基础：f_II + f_I + f_d = 1
children.bodyEn: Three branches sum to 1; sample 1.

formula.plainZh: T1 三道分支占比之和必须等于 1
formula.plainEn: Type II, Type I, and deactivation fractions must sum to one

children.titleZh: 原理：RK4 对拍与不确定性技能分
children.titleEn: Principle: RK4 gold & uncertainty skill scores

children.bodyZh: 通用技能分：预报评分相对参考（气候/朴素）改进比例。score 越小越好时 skill∈(−∞,1]；算例 1−0.2/0.5 = 0.6。对应 solvers 残差链 CRPS/Brier/log-skill 等（S20ab…S20aj）。

formula.plainZh: 技能分等于一减去预报评分与参考评分之比
formula.plainEn: Skill score is one minus forecast score over reference score

children.titleZh: 基础式：CRPS skill = 1 − CRPS / CRPS_ref
children.bodyZh: 连续排序概率评分的技能化：集合预报相对气候参考。算例 CRPS=0.08、CRPS_ref=0.2 → skill=0.6。
children.bodyEn: CRPS skill vs climatology; sample 0.6.

formula.plainZh: CRPS 技能分等于一减去集合 CRPS 与参考 CRPS 之比
formula.plainEn: CRPS skill is one minus ensemble CRPS over reference CRPS

children.bodyEn: Generation from quench, φ_T, and C_tot; sample 0.18.

formula.plainZh: 单线态氧生成率由 Type II 猝灭、三线态占比与总浓度合成

children.titleEn: Compose: T1_ss = a b C_tot / (1 + a + a b)

children.bodyEn: Composes a,b,C_tot into steady T1; sample 0.12 contracts with S0→S1→T1 chain.

children.titleEn: Compose: ¹O2_ss = k_q [³O2] φ_T C_tot / k_d
children.bodyZh: 把 Type II 猝灭、三线态占比、总浓度与 ¹O2 衰减合成单线态氧池稳态：¹O2_ss = G_ss/k_d = k_q O2 φ_T C_tot / k_d。默认 1.5·1·0.12·1/5 = 0.036。
children.bodyEn: Composes quench, φ_T, C_tot, and k_d into steady ¹O2; sample 0.036.

formula.expr: O1_ss = k_q * O2 * phiT * cTot / k_d
formula.plainZh: 单线态氧稳态由 Type II 猝灭、三线态占比、总浓度与衰减率合成
formula.plainEn: Steady ¹O2 composes Type II quench, triplet fraction, total concentration, and decay

children.titleZh: 合成：φ_T 从原始速率链

children.bodyZh: 把激发/出射/ISC/T1 失活合成：a=k_exc/(k_f+k_isc)、kTeff=k_T+k_q O2+k_I sub、b=k_isc/kTeff，再 φ_T=a b/(1+a+a b)。默认算例 → 0.12，闭合 Jablonski 速率→占比合同。
children.bodyEn: Full chain a,b from raw rates then φ_T; sample defaults → 0.12.

formula.plainZh: 稳态三线态占比由原始速率导出的 a、b 合成
formula.plainEn: Steady triplet fraction composes from a and b derived from raw rates

children.bodyZh: 把 Type II 分支占比与 T1 总失活、三线态浓度合成生成率：f_II·kTeff = k_q O2，故 G = f_II kTeff T1_ss。默认 0.75·2·0.12 = 0.18，与 k_q O2 T1 合同。
children.bodyEn: Composes branch fraction with kTeff and T1 into generation; sample 0.18 contracts with k_q O2 T1.

formula.plainZh: 单线态氧生成率由 Type II 分支占比、T1 总失活率与 T1 稳态浓度合成
formula.plainEn: ¹O2 generation composes Type II branch fraction, total T1 decay, and steady T1

children.titleZh: 合成：a、b 由速率参数
children.titleEn: Compose: a, b from rate parameters

children.bodyEn: Composes a and b from rates; sample product a·b=0.15 feeds φ_T numerator.

formula.plainZh: 稳态参数 a 与 b 的乘积构成三线态占比的分子
formula.plainEn: Product of steady parameters a and b forms the triplet-fraction numerator

children.titleZh: 合成：k_T,eff = k_T + k_q[³O2] + k_I[sub]
children.bodyZh: 把氧无关失活、Type II 猝灭与 Type I 底物道三伪一级率合成 T1 总失活。默认 0.2+1.5+0.3 = 2，再入 b 与 f_II。
children.bodyEn: Composes three pseudo-first-order T1 exits into kTeff; sample 2 feeds b and f_II.

formula.expr: kTeff = k_T + k_q * O2 + k_I * substrate
formula.plainZh: 三线态总失活率由氧无关、Type II 与 Type I 三道伪一级率合成
formula.plainEn: Triplet total decay composes O2-independent, Type II, and Type I rates

children.titleZh: 合成：a = k_exc / (k_f + k_isc)
children.bodyZh: 把激发与 S1 出射（荧光/内转换 + ISC）合成稳态参数 a。默认 0.5/(2+3)=0.1，再入 φ_T 与 S0 链。
children.bodyEn: Composes excitation and S1 outflow into a; sample 0.1 into φ_T/S0 chain.

formula.plainZh: 稳态参数 a 由激发率与 S1 总出射率合成
formula.plainEn: Steady parameter a composes excitation over total S1 outflow

children.titleZh: 合成：b = k_isc / k_T,eff
children.bodyZh: 把 ISC 进料与合成后的 kTeff 合成稳态参数 b。默认 3/2=1.5，与 a 乘积构成 φ_T 分子。
children.bodyEn: Composes ISC and kTeff into b; sample 1.5; a·b feeds φ_T numerator.

formula.plainZh: 稳态参数 b 由 ISC 率与 T1 总失活率合成
formula.plainEn: Steady parameter b composes ISC rate over total T1 decay

children.titleZh: 合成：S0_ss = C_tot / (1 + a + a b)
children.titleEn: Compose: S0_ss = C_tot / (1 + a + a b)
children.bodyZh: 把 a、b 与总浓度合成基态稳态。默认 C_tot=1、a=0.1、b=1.5 → S0=0.8，与 S1=a S0、T1=a b S0 合同。
children.bodyEn: Composes a,b,C_tot into steady S0; sample 0.8 contracts with S1/T1 chain.

formula.plainZh: 基态稳态浓度由总敏化剂与 a、b 分支参数合成
formula.plainEn: Steady S0 composes total sensitizer with branch parameters a and b

children.titleZh: 合成：S1_ss = a C_tot / (1 + a + a b)
children.titleEn: Compose: S1_ss = a C_tot / (1 + a + a b)

formula.plainZh: S1 稳态浓度可由 a、b 与总浓度直接合成
formula.plainEn: Steady S1 composes directly from a, b, and total concentration

children.bodyZh: 把 Type II 猝灭伪一级率与 kTeff 合成分支占比。默认 1.5/2=0.75，再入 G=f_II kTeff T1。

formula.plainZh: Type II 分支占比由氧猝灭伪一级率与 T1 总失活率合成
formula.plainEn: Type II branch fraction composes O2 quench rate over total T1 decay

formula.plainZh: RK4 单步由四斜率加权平均与时间步合成状态推进
formula.plainEn: RK4 step composes four weighted slopes with dt into the state update

children.titleZh: 合成：skill = 1 − score / score_ref

children.bodyEn: Composes forecast vs reference score into skill; sample 0.6; same shape for CRPS/Brier/log.

formula.plainZh: 技能分由预报评分与参考评分之比合成
